320URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int __attribute__((format(printf, 3, 4)))
321usbradio_log_fault(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, int already_logged, const char *fmt, ...)
322{
323 va_list ap;
324 char buf[512];
325
326 o->usb_faulted = 1;
327 va_start(ap, fmt);
328 vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
329 va_end(ap);
330
331 if (already_logged) {
332 ast_debug(1, "%s", buf);
333 } else {
334 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "%s", buf);
335 }
336 return 1;
337}

347URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL void usbradio_device_identity(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, char *devstr,
348 size_t devstr_size, char *serial,
349 size_t serial_size, int *alsa_card)
350{
351 if (devstr && devstr_size) {
352 devstr[0] = '\0';
353 }
354 if (serial && serial_size) {
355 serial[0] = '\0';
356 }
357 if (alsa_card) {
358 *alsa_card = -1;
359 }
360
361 /* Acquired device identity */
362 ast_mutex_lock(&o->device_lock);
363 if (o->radio_device) {
364 if (devstr && devstr_size) {
365 ast_copy_string(devstr, o->radio_device->devstr, devstr_size);
366 }
367 if (serial && serial_size && o->radio_device->serial) {
368 ast_copy_string(serial, o->radio_device->serial, serial_size);
369 }
370 if (alsa_card) {
371 *alsa_card = o->radio_device->alsa_card;
372 }
373 }
374 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->device_lock);
375}

380URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL void usbradio_log_usb_recovered(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
381{
382 char devstr[sizeof(o->devstr)];
383 sig_atomic_t was_faulted;
384
385 was_faulted = o->usb_faulted;
386 o->usb_faulted = 0;
387 if (!was_faulted) {
388 return;
389 }
390
391 /* Match fault priority so ERROR-level logs pair fault with recovery. */
392 usbradio_device_identity(o, devstr, sizeof(devstr), NULL, 0, NULL);
393 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Channel %s: USB radio device recovered (%s)\n", o->name,
394 S_OR(devstr, "unknown"));
395}

424struct chan_usbradio_pvt *find_desc(const char *dev)
425{
426 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o = NULL;
427
428 if (!dev) {
429 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "Cannot find USB descriptor <-- Null Descriptor -->.\n");
430 return NULL;
431 }
432 for (o = usbradio_default.next; o && strcmp(o->name, dev) != 0; o = o->next)
433 ;
434 if (!o) {
435 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "Cannot find USB descriptor <%s>.\n", dev);
436 return NULL;
437 }
438 return o;
439}

444URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL void usbradio_adjust_txmix_for_mono(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
445{
446 enum radio_tx_mix a = o->txmixa;
447 enum radio_tx_mix b = o->txmixb;
448
449 if (o->pa.output_channels != 1) {
450 return;
451 }
452
453 if (a == TX_OUT_OFF && b == TX_OUT_OFF) {
454 return;
455 }
456
457 if (a == TX_OUT_OFF) {
458 /* B holds the configured source; duplicate it to both channels. */
459 a = b;
460 } else if (b == TX_OUT_OFF) {
461 b = a;
462 } else if (a != b) {
463 /* Voice+tone on A/B is composite once PortAudio averages L/R. */
464 if ((a == TX_OUT_VOICE && b == TX_OUT_LSD) ||
465 (a == TX_OUT_LSD && b == TX_OUT_VOICE)) {
466 ast_log(LOG_WARNING,
467 "Channel %s: mono TX device; voice+tone A/B averaged into "
468 "composite (both sources kept)\n",
469 o->name);
470 o->txmixa = TX_OUT_COMPOSITE;
471 o->txmixb = TX_OUT_COMPOSITE;
472 if (o->radio) {
473 o->radio->txMixA = TX_OUT_COMPOSITE;
474 o->radio->txMixB = TX_OUT_COMPOSITE;
475 }
476 return;
477 }
478
479 ast_log(LOG_WARNING,
480 "Channel %s: unsupported txmixa/txmixb pair on mono TX; keeping A, "
481 "disabling B\n",
482 o->name);
483 b = a;
484 }
485
486 if (a != o->txmixa || b != o->txmixb) {
487 ast_log(LOG_WARNING,
488 "Channel %s: mono TX device; forcing equal A/B mix so PortAudio downmix "
489 "stays full level\n",
490 o->name);
491 }
492
493 o->txmixa = a;
494 o->txmixb = b;
495
496 if (o->radio) {
497 o->radio->txMixA = a;
498 o->radio->txMixB = b;
499 }
500}

542URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int usbradio_swap_hid_wait(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
543{
544 int swapping;
545
546 ast_mutex_lock(&o->swap_lock);
547 swapping = o->swap_state == DEVICE_SWAP_QUIESCING;
548 while (swapping && !o->swap_audio_ready && !o->stophid) {
549 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->swap_lock);
550 usleep(10000);
551 ast_mutex_lock(&o->swap_lock);
552 swapping = o->swap_state == DEVICE_SWAP_QUIESCING;
553 }
554 if (swapping && o->swap_audio_ready) {
555 o->swap_state = DEVICE_SWAP_READY;
556 } else {
557 swapping = 0;
558 }
559 while (o->swap_state == DEVICE_SWAP_READY && !o->stophid) {
560 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->swap_lock);
561 usleep(10000);
562 ast_mutex_lock(&o->swap_lock);
563 }
564 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->swap_lock);
565 return swapping;
566}
567
572URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int usbradio_swap_ready(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
573{

576 ast_mutex_lock(&o->swap_lock);

578 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->swap_lock);

580}

662URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int init_audio_device(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
663{
664 struct ast_radio_device *radio_device;
665 struct ast_radio_device_request request = {
666 .devstr = o->devstr,
667 .serial = o->serial,
668 .owner = o->name,
669 .required_caps = AST_RADIO_CAP_CM108_HID,
670 .minimum_input_channels = 1,
671 .minimum_output_channels = 1,
672 };
673 enum ast_radio_device_result result;
674 int automatic;
675
676 automatic = ast_strlen_zero(request.serial) && ast_strlen_zero(request.devstr);
677 result = ast_radio_device_acquire(&request, &radio_device);
678 if (result != AST_RADIO_DEVICE_READY) {
679 if (o->device_error != result) {
680 usbradio_log_fault(o, 0, "Channel %s: %s\n", o->name,
681 ast_radio_device_result_str(result));
682 }
683 o->device_error = result;
684 return -1;
685 }
686
687 /* Required receive and transmit mixer limits */
688 if (ast_radio_device_mixer_max(radio_device, radio_device->mixer_rx_paths,
689 AST_RADIO_MIXER_CAPTURE_VOLUME) <= 0 ||
690 ast_radio_device_mixer_max(radio_device, radio_device->mixer_tx_paths,
691 AST_RADIO_MIXER_PLAYBACK_VOLUME) <= 0) {
692 usbradio_log_fault(
693 o, 0, "Channel %s: Cannot use USB radio device %s without mixer limits\n",
694 o->name, radio_device->devstr);
695 ast_radio_device_release(radio_device);
696 o->device_error = AST_RADIO_DEVICE_ERROR;
697 return -1;
698 }
699
700 /* Acquired device publication without configured selector changes */
701 ast_mutex_lock(&o->device_lock);
702 o->radio_device = radio_device;
703 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->device_lock);
704 o->device_error = AST_RADIO_DEVICE_READY;
705
706 if (automatic) {
707 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE, "Channel %s: Automatically assigned USB device %s\n", o->name,
708 radio_device->devstr);
709 }
710 return 0;
711}

717URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int usbradio_start_audio(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
718{
719 char devstr[sizeof(o->devstr)];
720 PaError res;
721
722 if (o->pa.active) {
723 return 0;
724 }
725
726 /* Exact PortAudio endpoints from the active device lease */
727 ast_mutex_lock(&o->device_lock);
728 if (!o->radio_device) {
729 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->device_lock);
730 return -1;
731 }
732 ast_copy_string(devstr, o->radio_device->devstr, sizeof(devstr));
733 o->pa.input_channels = o->radio_device->pa_input_channels >= 2 ? 2 : 1;
734 res = ast_radio_pa_open_device(&o->pa, o->radio_device);
735 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->device_lock);
736 if (res != paNoError) {
737 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "Channel %s: Unable to open PortAudio stream for %s (%s)\n",
738 o->name, devstr, Pa_GetErrorText(res));
739 return -1;
740 }
741
742 usbradio_adjust_txmix_for_mono(o);
743
744 res = ast_radio_pa_start(&o->pa);
745 if (res != paNoError) {
746 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "Channel %s: Unable to start PortAudio stream for %s (%s)\n",
747 o->name, devstr, Pa_GetErrorText(res));
748 ast_radio_pa_stop(&o->pa);
749 return -1;
750 }
751
752 return 0;
753}
754
755URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL void *hidthread(void *arg)
756{
757 unsigned char buf[4], bufsave[4], keyed, ctcssed;
758 char lasttxtmp;
759 int i, j, k;
760 int res;
761 int open_device_failed = 0;
762 int detach_failed = 0;
763 int claim_failed = 0;
764 int pipe_failed = 0;
765 int start_audio_failed = 0;
766 struct libusb_device_handle *usb_handle;
767 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o = arg;
768 struct timeval then;
769 struct pollfd rfds[1];
770
771 usb_handle = NULL;
772 /* enable gpio_set so that we will write GPIO information upon start up */
773 o->gpio_set = 1;
774
775#ifdef HAVE_SYS_IO
776 if (haspp == 2) {
777 ioperm(pbase, 2, 1);
778 }
779#endif
780 /* This is the main loop for this thread.
781 * It performs setup and initialization of the usb device.
782 * After setup is complete and the device can be accessed,
783 * it enters a processing loop responsible for interacting
784 * with the usb hid device
785 */
786 while (!o->stophid) {
787 ast_radio_time(&o->lasthidtime);
788
789 /* Prior device teardown */
790 o->hasusb = 0;
791
792 if (usb_handle) {
793 libusb_close(usb_handle);
794 usb_handle = NULL;
795 }
796
797 /* Park the lease after both HID and audio have stopped for a device swap */
798 if (usbradio_swap_hid_wait(o)) {
799 continue;
800 }
801 usbradio_release_device(o);
802
803 /* Shared USB radio device discovery and reservation */
804 /* The previous iteration always releases its lease before discovery. */
805 if (init_audio_device(o)) {
806 usleep(500000);
807 continue;
808 }
809
810 /* Open the USB device */
811 if (libusb_open(o->radio_device->usb_device, &usb_handle) < 0) {
812 open_device_failed = usbradio_log_fault(
813 o, open_device_failed, "Channel %s: Cannot open device %s\n",
814 o->name, o->radio_device->devstr);
815 usleep(500000);
816 continue;
817 }
818 /* attempt to claim the usb hid interface and detach from the kernel */
819 if (libusb_claim_interface(usb_handle, C108_HID_INTERFACE) < 0) {
820 if (libusb_detach_kernel_driver(usb_handle, C108_HID_INTERFACE) < 0) {
821 detach_failed = usbradio_log_fault(
822 o, detach_failed,
823 "Channel %s: Is not able to detach the USB device\n",
824 o->name);
825 usleep(500000);
826 continue;
827 }
828 if (libusb_claim_interface(usb_handle, C108_HID_INTERFACE) < 0) {
829 claim_failed = usbradio_log_fault(
830 o, claim_failed,
831 "Channel %s: Is not able to claim the USB device\n",
832 o->name);
833 usleep(500000);
834 continue;
835 }
836 }
837 /* write initial value to GPIO */
838 memset(buf, 0, sizeof(buf));
839 buf[o->hid_gpio_ctl_loc] = o->hid_gpio_ctl;
840 buf[o->hid_gpio_loc] = o->hid_gpio_val;
841 ast_radio_hid_set_outputs(usb_handle, buf);
842 memcpy(bufsave, buf, sizeof(buf));
843 /* setup the pttkick pipe
844 * this pipe is used for timing the main processing loop
845 * it also signaled when the ptt changes to exit the timer
846 */
847 if (o->pttkick[0] != -1) {
848 close(o->pttkick[0]);
849 o->pttkick[0] = -1;
850 }
851 if (o->pttkick[1] != -1) {
852 close(o->pttkick[1]);
853 o->pttkick[1] = -1;
854 }
855 if (pipe2(o->pttkick, O_NONBLOCK) == -1) {
856 pipe_failed = usbradio_log_fault(
857 o, pipe_failed, "Channel %s: Is not able to create a pipe\n",
858 o->name);
859 libusb_close(usb_handle);
860 usb_handle = NULL;
861 o->hasusb = 0;
862 /* Stay in hidthread and retry; call() only starts the thread once. */
863 usleep(500000);
864 continue;
865 }
866
867 /* Existing HID product-family mapping */
868 if ((o->radio_device->product_id & 0xfffc) == C108_PRODUCT_ID) {
869 o->devtype = C108_PRODUCT_ID;
870 } else {
871 o->devtype = o->radio_device->product_id;
872 }
873 ast_debug(5, "Channel %s: Starting normally.\n", o->name);
874
875 ast_debug(5, "Channel %s: Attached to USB device %s.\n", o->name,
876 o->radio_device->devstr);
877 /* setup the xmpr subsystem */
878 if (o->radio == NULL) {
879 urp_radio_state tChan;
880
881 memset(&tChan, 0, sizeof(urp_radio_state));
882
883 tChan.pTxCodeDefault = o->txctcssdefault;
884 tChan.pRxCodeSrc = o->rxctcssfreqs;
885 tChan.pTxCodeSrc = o->txctcssfreqs;
886
887 tChan.rxDemod = o->rxdemod;
888 tChan.rxCdType = effective_rxcdtype(o);
889 tChan.voxHangTime = o->voxhangtime;
890 tChan.rxSqVoxAdj = o->rxsqvoxadj;
891
892 tChan.txMixA = effective_txmixa(o);
893 tChan.txMixB = effective_txmixb(o);
894
895 tChan.rxCpuSaver = o->rxcpusaver;
896 tChan.txCpuSaver = o->txcpusaver;
897
898 tChan.b.rxpolarity = o->rxpolarity;
899 tChan.b.txpolarity = o->txpolarity;
900
901 tChan.b.dcsrxpolarity = o->dcsrxpolarity;
902 tChan.b.dcstxpolarity = o->dcstxpolarity;
903
904 tChan.b.lsdrxpolarity = o->lsdrxpolarity;
905 tChan.b.lsdtxpolarity = o->lsdtxpolarity;
906
907 tChan.tracetype = o->tracetype;
908 tChan.tracelevel = o->tracelevel;
909
910 tChan.rptnum = o->rptnum;
911 tChan.idleinterval = o->idleinterval;
912 tChan.turnoffs = o->turnoffs;
913 tChan.area = o->area;
914 tChan.ukey = o->ukey;
915 tChan.name = o->name;
916 tChan.fever = o->fever;
917
918 o->radio = urp_radio_create(&tChan, FRAME_SIZE);
919 if (!o->radio) {
920 ast_log(LOG_ERROR,
921 "Channel %s: signaling engine initialization failed\n",
922 o->name);
923 usleep(500000);
924 continue;
925 }
926
927 o->radio->radioDuplex = o->radioduplex;
928 o->radio->b.loopback = 0;
929 o->radio->txsettletime = o->txsettletime;
930 o->radio->txrxblankingtime = o->txrxblankingtime;
931 o->radio->rxCpuSaver = o->rxcpusaver;
932 o->radio->txCpuSaver = o->txcpusaver;
933
934 *(o->radio->prxSquelchAdjust) =
935 ((999 - o->rxsquelchadj) * 32767) / AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT;
936 *(o->radio->prxVoiceAdjust) = effective_rx_decoder_gain(o) * M_Q8;
937 *(o->radio->prxCtcssAdjust) = o->rxctcssadj * M_Q8;
938 o->radio->rxCtcss->relax = o->rxctcssrelax;
939 o->radio->txTocType = o->txtoctype;
940
941 if (urp_tx_pair_has_tone((enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixa,
942 (enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixb)) {
943 set_txctcss_level(o);
944 }
945
946 if (!urp_tx_pair_has_voice((enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixa,
947 (enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixb)) {
948 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Channel %s: No txvoice output configured.\n",
949 o->name);
950 }
951
952 if (urp_tx_tone_route_missing(o->txctcssfreq,
953 (enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixa,
954 (enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixb)) {
955 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "No txtone output configured.\n");
956 }
957
958 if (o->radioactive) {
959 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *ao;
960 for (ao = usbradio_default.next; ao; ao = ao->next)
961 ao->radioactive = 0;
962 usbradio_active = o->name;
963 o->radioactive = 1;
964 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE, "radio active set to [%s]\n", o->name);
965 }
966 }
967 radio_config(o);
968 mixer_write(o);
969 mult_set(o);
970
971 if (apply_processing_config_overrides(o, o->name))
972 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "Unable to apply current RadioPlus settings for %s\n",
973 o->name);
974
975 mixer_write(o);
976 mult_set(o);
977 set_txctcss_level(o);
978
979 ast_mutex_lock(&o->eepromlock);
980 if (o->wanteeprom) {
981 o->eepromctl = 1;
982 }
983 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->eepromlock);
984
985 if (usbradio_start_audio(o) < 0) {
986 start_audio_failed = usbradio_log_fault(
987 o, start_audio_failed, "Channel %s: Unable to start audio stream\n",
988 o->name);
989 usleep(500000);
990 continue;
991 }
992 /* Reset the failure flags, we succeeded */
993 open_device_failed = 0;
994 detach_failed = 0;
995 claim_failed = 0;
996 pipe_failed = 0;
997 start_audio_failed = 0;
998 usbradio_log_usb_recovered(o);
999 o->hasusb = 1;
1000 o->had_gpios_in = 0;
1001
1002 memset(&rfds, 0, sizeof(rfds));
1003 rfds[0].fd = o->pttkick[1];
1004 rfds[0].events = POLLIN;
1005
1006 ast_radio_time(&o->lasthidtime);
1007 /* Main processing loop for GPIO
1008 * This loop process every 50 milliseconds.
1009 * The timer can be interrupted by writing to
1010 * the pttkick pipe.
1011 */
1012 while ((!o->stophid) && o->hasusb) {
1013 time_t audio_time_now = 0;
1014
1015 then = ast_radio_tvnow();
1016 if (o->lastaudiotime) {
1017 /* HID thread monitors audio thread */
1018 ast_radio_time(&audio_time_now);
1019 if ((audio_time_now - o->lastaudiotime) > 3) {
1020 usbradio_log_fault(o, 0,
1021 "Channel %s: Audio process has died or "
1022 "is not responding.\n",
1023 o->name);
1024 o->hasusb = 0;
1025 break;
1026 }
1027 }
1028 /* poll the pttkick pipe - timeout after 50 milliseconds */
1029 res = ast_poll(rfds, 1, 50);
1030 if (res < 0) {
1031 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "Channel %s: Poll failed: %s\n", o->name,
1032 strerror(errno));
1033 usleep(10000);
1034 continue;
1035 }
1036 if (rfds[0].revents) {
1037 char c;
1038
1039 int bytes = read(o->pttkick[0], &c, 1);
1040 if (bytes <= 0) {
1041 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Channel %s: pttkick read failed: %s\n",
1042 o->name, strerror(errno));
1043 }
1044 }
1045 /* see if we need to process an eeprom read or write */
1046 if (o->wanteeprom) {
1047 ast_mutex_lock(&o->eepromlock);
1048 if (o->eepromctl == 1) { /* to read */
1049 /* if CS okay */
1050 if (!ast_radio_get_eeprom(usb_handle, o->eeprom)) {
1051 if (o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_MAGIC_ADDR] !=
1052 EEPROM_MAGIC) {
1053 ast_log(LOG_ERROR,
1054 "Channel %s: EEPROM bad magic "
1055 "number\n",
1056 o->name);
1057 } else {
1058 o->rxmixerset =
1059 o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_RXMIXERSET];
1060 o->txmixaset =
1061 o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_TXMIXASET];
1062 o->txmixbset =
1063 o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_TXMIXBSET];
1064 o->txctcssadj =
1065 o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_TXCTCSSADJ];
1066 o->rxsquelchadj =
1067 o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_RXSQUELCHADJ];
1068 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE,
1069 "Channel %s: EEPROM Loaded\n",
1070 o->name);
1071 mixer_write(o);
1072 mult_set(o);
1073 set_txctcss_level(o);
1074 }
1075 } else {
1076 ast_log(LOG_ERROR,
1077 "Channel %s: USB adapter has no EEPROM "
1078 "installed or Checksum is bad\n",
1079 o->name);
1080 }
1081 ast_radio_hid_set_outputs(usb_handle, bufsave);
1082 }
1083 if (o->eepromctl == 2) { /* to write */
1084 ast_radio_put_eeprom(usb_handle, o->eeprom);
1085 ast_radio_hid_set_outputs(usb_handle, bufsave);
1086 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE,
1087 "Channel %s: USB parameters written to EEPROM\n",
1088 o->name);
1089 }
1090 o->eepromctl = 0;
1091 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->eepromlock);
1092 }
1093 ast_mutex_lock(&o->usblock);
1094 buf[o->hid_gpio_ctl_loc] = o->hid_gpio_ctl;
1095 ast_radio_hid_get_inputs(usb_handle, buf);
1096 /* See if we are keyed */
1097 keyed = !(buf[o->hid_io_cor_loc] & o->hid_io_cor);
1098 if (keyed != o->rxhidsq) {
1099 ast_debug(2, "Channel %s: Update rxhidsq = %d\n", o->name, keyed);
1100 o->rxhidsq = keyed;
1101 }
1102 /* See if we are receiving ctcss */
1103 ctcssed = !(buf[o->hid_io_ctcss_loc] & o->hid_io_ctcss);
1104 if (ctcssed != o->rxhidctcss) {
1105 ast_debug(2, "Channel %s: Update rxhidctcss = %d\n", o->name,
1106 ctcssed);
1107 o->rxhidctcss = ctcssed;
1108 }
1109 /* Get the GPIO information */
1110 j = buf[o->hid_gpio_loc];
1111 /* If this device is a CM108AH, map the "HOOK" bit (which used to
1112 be GPIO2 in the CM108 into the GPIO position */
1113 if (o->devtype == C108AH_PRODUCT_ID) {
1114 j |= 2; /* set GPIO2 bit */
1115 /* if HOOK is asserted, clear GPIO bit */
1116 if (buf[o->hid_io_cor_loc] & 0x10) {
1117 j &= ~2;
1118 }
1119 }
1120 for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PINCOUNT; i++) {
1121 /* if a valid input bit, dont clear it */
1122 if ((o->gpios[i]) && (!strcasecmp(o->gpios[i], "in")) &&
1123 (o->valid_gpios & (1 << i))) {
1124 continue;
1125 }
1126 j &= ~(1 << i); /* clear the bit, since its not an input */
1127 }
1128 if ((!o->had_gpios_in) || (o->last_gpios_in != j)) {
1129 char buf1[100];
1130 struct ast_frame fr = {
1131 .frametype = AST_FRAME_TEXT,
1132 .src = __PRETTY_FUNCTION__,
1133 };
1134
1135 for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PINCOUNT; i++) {
1136 /* skip if not specified */
1137 if (!o->gpios[i]) {
1138 continue;
1139 }
1140 /* skip if not input */
1141 if (strcasecmp(o->gpios[i], "in")) {
1142 continue;
1143 }
1144 /* skip if not a valid GPIO */
1145 if (!(o->valid_gpios & (1 << i))) {
1146 continue;
1147 }
1148 /* if bit has changed, or never reported */
1149 if ((!o->had_gpios_in) ||
1150 ((o->last_gpios_in & (1 << i)) != (j & (1 << i)))) {
1151 snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "GPIO%d %d\n", i + 1,
1152 (j & (1 << i)) ? 1 : 0);
1153 fr.data.ptr = buf1;
1154 fr.datalen = strlen(buf1);
1155 ast_queue_frame(o->owner, &fr);
1156 }
1157 }
1158 o->had_gpios_in = 1;
1159 o->last_gpios_in = j;
1160 }
1161 /* process the parallel port GPIO */
1162 if (haspp) {
1163 ast_mutex_lock(&pp_lock);
1164 j = k = ast_radio_ppread(haspp, ppfd, pbase, pport) ^
1165 0x80; /* get PP input */
1166 ast_mutex_unlock(&pp_lock);
1167 for (i = 10; i <= 15; i++) {
1168 /* if a valid input bit, dont clear it */
1169 if ((o->pps[i]) && (!strcasecmp(o->pps[i], "in"))) {
1170 continue;
1171 }
1172 j &= ~(1 << ppinshift[i]); /* clear the bit, since its not
1173 an input */
1174 }
1175 if ((!o->had_pp_in) || (o->last_pp_in != j)) {
1176 char buf1[100];
1177 struct ast_frame fr = {
1178 .frametype = AST_FRAME_TEXT,
1179 .src = __PRETTY_FUNCTION__,
1180 };
1181
1182 for (i = 10; i <= 15; i++) {
1183 /* skip if not specified */
1184 if (!o->pps[i]) {
1185 continue;
1186 }
1187 /* skip if not input */
1188 if (strcasecmp(o->pps[i], "in")) {
1189 continue;
1190 }
1191 /* if bit has changed, or never reported */
1192 if ((!o->had_pp_in) ||
1193 ((o->last_pp_in & (1 << ppinshift[i])) !=
1194 (j & (1 << ppinshift[i])))) {
1195 snprintf(buf1, sizeof(buf1), "PP%d %d\n", i,
1196 (j & (1 << ppinshift[i])) ? 1 : 0);
1197 fr.data.ptr = buf1;
1198 fr.datalen = strlen(buf1);
1199 ast_queue_frame(o->owner, &fr);
1200 }
1201 }
1202 o->had_pp_in = 1;
1203 o->last_pp_in = j;
1204 }
1205 o->rxppsq = o->rxppctcss = 0;
1206 for (i = 10; i <= 15; i++) {
1207 if ((o->pps[i]) && (!strcasecmp(o->pps[i], "cor"))) {
1208 j = k &
1209 (1
1210 << ppinshift[i]); /* set the bit accordingly */
1211 if (j != o->rxppsq) {
1212 ast_debug(
1213 2,
1214 "Channel %s: update rxppsq = %d\n",
1215 o->name, j);
1216 o->rxppsq = j;
1217 }
1218 } else if ((o->pps[i]) &&
1219 (!strcasecmp(o->pps[i], "ctcss"))) {
1220 o->rxppctcss =
1221 k & (1 << ppinshift[i]); /* set the bit
1222 accordingly */
1223 }
1224 }
1225 }
1226 j = ast_tvdiff_ms(ast_radio_tvnow(), then);
1227 /* make output inversion mask (for pulseage) */
1228 o->hid_gpio_lastmask = o->hid_gpio_pulsemask;
1229 o->hid_gpio_pulsemask = 0;
1230 for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PINCOUNT; i++) {
1231 k = o->hid_gpio_pulsetimer[i];
1232 if (k) {
1233 k -= j;
1234 if (k < 0) {
1235 k = 0;
1236 }
1237 o->hid_gpio_pulsetimer[i] = k;
1238 }
1239 if (k) {
1240 o->hid_gpio_pulsemask |= 1 << i;
1241 }
1242 }
1243 if (o->hid_gpio_pulsemask ||
1244 o->hid_gpio_lastmask) { /* if anything inverted (temporarily) */
1245 buf[o->hid_gpio_loc] = o->hid_gpio_val ^ o->hid_gpio_pulsemask;
1246 buf[o->hid_gpio_ctl_loc] = o->hid_gpio_ctl;
1247 ast_radio_hid_set_outputs(usb_handle, buf);
1248 }
1249 if (o->gpio_set) {
1250 o->gpio_set = 0;
1251 buf[o->hid_gpio_loc] = o->hid_gpio_val ^ o->hid_gpio_pulsemask;
1252 buf[o->hid_gpio_ctl_loc] = o->hid_gpio_ctl;
1253 ast_radio_hid_set_outputs(usb_handle, buf);
1254 }
1255 /* Apply transmitter state changes from the signaling engine. */
1256 lasttxtmp = o->radio->txPttOut;
1257
1258 k = 0;
1259 if (haspp) {
1260 for (i = 2; i <= 9; i++) {
1261 /* skip if this one not specified */
1262 if (!o->pps[i]) {
1263 continue;
1264 }
1265 /* skip if not ptt */
1266 if (strncasecmp(o->pps[i], "ptt", 3)) {
1267 continue;
1268 }
1269 k |= (1 << (i - 2)); /* make mask */
1270 }
1271 }
1272 if (o->lasttx != lasttxtmp) {
1273 o->radio->txPttHid = o->lasttx = lasttxtmp;
1274 ast_debug(2, "Channel %s: tx set to %d\n", o->name, o->lasttx);
1275 ast_mutex_lock(&pp_lock);
1276 urp_apply_ptt_outputs(lasttxtmp, o->invertptt, (uint8_t)k,
1277 o->hid_io_ptt, &o->hid_gpio_val, &pp_val);
1278 if (k) {
1279 ast_radio_ppwrite(haspp, ppfd, pbase, pport, pp_val);
1280 }
1281 ast_mutex_unlock(&pp_lock);
1282 buf[o->hid_gpio_loc] = o->hid_gpio_val ^ o->hid_gpio_pulsemask;
1283 buf[o->hid_gpio_ctl_loc] = o->hid_gpio_ctl;
1284 memcpy(bufsave, buf, sizeof(buf));
1285 ast_radio_hid_set_outputs(usb_handle, buf);
1286 }
1287 ast_radio_time(&o->lasthidtime);
1288 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->usblock);
1289 }
1290 o->radio->txPttOut = 0;
1291 o->lasttx = 0;
1292 ast_mutex_lock(&o->usblock);
1293 o->hid_gpio_val &= ~o->hid_io_ptt;
1294 if (o->invertptt) {
1295 o->hid_gpio_val |= o->hid_io_ptt;
1296 }
1297 buf[o->hid_gpio_loc] = o->hid_gpio_val ^ o->hid_gpio_pulsemask;
1298 buf[o->hid_gpio_ctl_loc] = o->hid_gpio_ctl;
1299 ast_radio_hid_set_outputs(usb_handle, buf);
1300 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->usblock);
1301 }
1302 /* clean up before exiting the thread */
1303 if (o->radio) {
1304 o->radio->txPttOut = 0;
1305 }
1306 o->lasttx = 0;
1307 if (usb_handle) {
1308 ast_mutex_lock(&o->usblock);
1309 o->hid_gpio_val &= ~o->hid_io_ptt;
1310 if (o->invertptt) {
1311 o->hid_gpio_val |= o->hid_io_ptt;
1312 }
1313 buf[o->hid_gpio_loc] = o->hid_gpio_val;
1314 buf[o->hid_gpio_ctl_loc] = o->hid_gpio_ctl;
1315 ast_radio_hid_set_outputs(usb_handle, buf);
1316 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->usblock);
1317 /* Hangup joins this thread; release HID so the next call can reopen it. */
1318 libusb_close(usb_handle);
1319 usb_handle = NULL;
1320 }
1321
1322 usbradio_release_device(o);
1323
1324 return NULL;
1325}
1326
1327URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int soundcard_writeframe(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, short *data)
1328{
1329 PaError res;
1330
1331 if (!o->pa.active) {
1332 if (usbradio_start_audio(o) < 0) {
1333 return 0;
1334 }
1335 }
1336
1337 /*
1338 * Always write something so the USB TX buffer does not intentionally
1339 * underrun (same idea as simpleusb #1161). Radio PTT is HID-gated;
1340 * when unkeyed, feed silence instead of the rendered TX buffer.
1341 */
1342 if (!o->radio->txPttIn && !o->radio->txPttOut) {
1343 data = silence_buf;
1344 }
1345
1346 /*
1347 * ast_radio_pa_write() already primes one silence frame on
1348 * paOutputUnderflowed (#593 / #598). Treat that as success here.
1349 */
1350 res = ast_radio_pa_write(&o->pa, data, AST_RADIO_PA_FRAMES_PER_BUFFER);
1351 if (res < 0 && res != paOutputUnderflowed) {
1352 usbradio_log_fault(
1353 o, 0, "Channel %s: PortAudio write failed (%s); restarting audio stream\n",
1354 o->name, Pa_GetErrorText(res));
1355 /* Force HID reinit so recovery log clears the latch. */
1356 o->hasusb = 0;
1357 ast_radio_pa_stop(&o->pa);
1358 return 0;
1359 }
1360
1361 return AST_RADIO_PA_FRAMES_PER_BUFFER * AST_RADIO_PA_OUTPUT_CHANNELS * (int)sizeof(short);
1362}
1363
1368URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL PaError usbradio_read_pa_stereo(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
1369{
1370 short *stereo = (short *)(o->usbradio_read_buf + AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET);
1371 PaError pa_res;
1372
1373 if (o->pa.input_channels == 1) {
1374 short mono_buf[AST_RADIO_PA_FRAMES_PER_BUFFER];
1375
1376 pa_res = ast_radio_pa_read(&o->pa, mono_buf, AST_RADIO_PA_FRAMES_PER_BUFFER, 40,
1377 &o->stopaudiothread);
1378 if (pa_res == paNoError) {
1379 for (int i = AST_RADIO_PA_FRAMES_PER_BUFFER - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
1380 stereo[i * 2] = mono_buf[i];
1381 stereo[i * 2 + 1] = mono_buf[i];
1382 }
1383 }
1384 return pa_res;
1385 }
1386
1387 return ast_radio_pa_read(&o->pa, stereo, AST_RADIO_PA_FRAMES_PER_BUFFER, 40,
1388 &o->stopaudiothread);
1389}
1390
1391URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int usbradio_text(struct ast_channel *c, const char *text)
1392{
1393 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o = ast_channel_tech_pvt(c);
1394 char cmd[16], pwr;
1395 int cnt, i, j;
1396 double tx, rx;
1397
1398#define STR_SZ 15 /* Size of text strings */
1399 char rxs[STR_SZ + 1], txs[STR_SZ + 1], txpl[STR_SZ + 1], rxpl[STR_SZ + 1];
1400 if (!o) {
1401 return -1;
1402 }
1403
1404#ifdef HAVE_SYS_IO
1405 if (haspp == 2) {
1406 ioperm(pbase, 2, 1);
1407 }
1408#endif
1409
1410 cmd[0] = rxs[0] = txs[0] = rxpl[0] = txpl[0] = pwr = '\0';
1411
1412 /* print received messages */
1413 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: Console Received usbradio text %s >>\n", o->name, text);
1414
1415 cnt = sscanf(text, "%15s " S_FMT(STR_SZ) S_FMT(STR_SZ) S_FMT(STR_SZ) S_FMT(STR_SZ) "%c",
1416 cmd, rxs, txs, rxpl, txpl, &pwr);
1417
1418 /* set channel on parallel port */
1419 if (strcmp(cmd, "SETCHAN") == 0) {
1420 u8 chan;
1421 chan = strtod(rxs, NULL);
1422 usbradioplus_set_channel(chan);
1423 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: SETCHAN cmd: %s chan: %i\n", o->name, text, chan);
1424 return 0;
1425 }
1426
1427 /* set receive CTCSS */
1428 if (strcmp(cmd, "RXCTCSS") == 0) {
1429 u8 x;
1430 x = strtod(rxs, NULL);
1431 o->rxctcssoverride = !x;
1432 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: RXCTCSS cmd: %s\n", o->name, text);
1433 return 0;
1434 }
1435
1436 /* set transmit CTCSS (app_rpt itxctcss → TXCTCSS 0/1) */
1437 if (strcmp(cmd, "TXCTCSS") == 0) {
1438 if (cnt < 2 || (strcmp(rxs, "0") && strcmp(rxs, "1"))) {
1439 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "Channel %s: Invalid TXCTCSS command: %s\n", o->name,
1440 text);
1441 return 0;
1442 }
1443 if (o->radio) {
1444 o->radio->b.txCtcssOff = rxs[0] != '1';
1445 }
1446 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: TXCTCSS cmd: %s\n", o->name, text);
1447 return 0;
1448 }
1449
1450 /* GPIO command */
1451 if (!strncmp(text, "GPIO", 4)) {
1452 cnt = sscanf(text, "%15s " N_FMT(d) " " N_FMT(d), cmd, &i, &j);
1453 if (cnt < 3) {
1454 return 0;
1455 }
1456 if ((i < 1) || (i > GPIO_PINCOUNT)) {
1457 return 0;
1458 }
1459 i--;
1460 /* skip if not valid */
1461 if (!(o->valid_gpios & (1 << i))) {
1462 return 0;
1463 }
1464 ast_mutex_lock(&o->usblock);
1465 if (j > 1) { /* if to request pulse-age */
1466 o->hid_gpio_pulsetimer[i] = j - 1;
1467 } else {
1468 /* clear pulsetimer, if in the middle of running */
1469 o->hid_gpio_pulsetimer[i] = 0;
1470 o->hid_gpio_val &= ~(1 << i);
1471 if (j) {
1472 o->hid_gpio_val |= 1 << i;
1473 }
1474 o->gpio_set = 1;
1475 }
1476 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->usblock);
1477 kickptt(o);
1478 return 0;
1479 }
1480
1481 /* Parallel port command */
1482 if (!strncmp(text, "PP", 2)) {
1483 cnt = sscanf(text, "%15s " N_FMT(d) " " N_FMT(d), cmd, &i, &j);
1484 if (cnt < 3) {
1485 return 0;
1486 }
1487 if ((i < 2) || (i > 9)) {
1488 return 0;
1489 }
1490 ast_mutex_lock(&pp_lock);
1491 if (j > 1) { /* if to request pulse-age */
1492 pp_pulsetimer[i] = j - 1;
1493 } else {
1494 /* clear pulsetimer, if in the middle of running */
1495 pp_pulsetimer[i] = 0;
1496 pp_val &= ~(1 << (i - 2));
1497 if (j) {
1498 pp_val |= 1 << (i - 2);
1499 }
1500 ast_radio_ppwrite(haspp, ppfd, pbase, pport, pp_val);
1501 }
1502 ast_mutex_unlock(&pp_lock);
1503 return 0;
1504 }
1505
1506 if (cnt < 6) {
1507 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Channel %s: Cannot parse usbradio text: %s\n", o->name, text);
1508 return 0;
1509 } else {
1510 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: << %s %s %s %s %s %c >> \n", o->name, cmd, rxs, txs, rxpl,
1511 txpl, pwr);
1512 }
1513
1514 /* set frequency command */
1515 if (strcmp(cmd, "SETFREQ") == 0) {
1516 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: SETFREQ cmd: %s\n", o->name, text);
1517 tx = strtod(txs, NULL);
1518 rx = strtod(rxs, NULL);
1519 o->set_txfreq = round(tx * (double)1000000);
1520 o->set_rxfreq = round(rx * (double)1000000);
1521 o->set_txpower = (pwr == 'H');
1522 ast_copy_string(o->set_rxctcssfreqs, rxpl, sizeof(o->set_rxctcssfreqs));
1523 ast_copy_string(o->set_txctcssfreqs, txpl, sizeof(o->set_txctcssfreqs));
1524
1525 o->remoted = 1;
1526 radio_config(o);
1527 return 0;
1528 }
1529 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Channel %s: Cannot parse usbradio cmd: %s\n", o->name, text);
1530 return 0;
1531}
1532
1533URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int usbradio_call(struct ast_channel *c, const char *dest, int timeout)
1534{
1535 (void)dest;
1536 (void)timeout;
1537 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o = ast_channel_tech_pvt(c);
1538
1539 if (o->hidthread == AST_PTHREADT_NULL) {
1540 o->stophid = 0;
1541 ast_radio_time(&o->lasthidtime);
1542 if (ast_pthread_create(&o->hidthread, NULL, hidthread, o)) {
1543 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Channel %s: Failed to create HID thread\n", o->name);
1544 return -1;
1545 }
1546 }
1547 if (o->audiothread == AST_PTHREADT_NULL) {
1548 o->stopaudiothread = 0;
1549 o->audio_thread_ready = 0;
1550 ast_radio_time(&o->lastaudiotime);
1551 if (ast_pthread_create(&o->audiothread, NULL, usbradio_audio_thread, o)) {
1552 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Channel %s: Failed to create audio thread\n", o->name);
1553 o->stophid = 1;
1554 kickptt(o);
1555 /* HID is necessarily running: its creation precedes this attempt. */
1556 pthread_join(o->hidthread, NULL);
1557 o->hidthread = AST_PTHREADT_NULL;
1558 return -1;
1559 }
1560 }
1561 ast_setstate(c, AST_STATE_UP);
1562 return 0;
1563}
1564
1565URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int usbradio_hangup(struct ast_channel *c)
1566{
1567 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o = ast_channel_tech_pvt(c);
1568
1569 o->stopaudiothread = 1;
1570 o->stophid = 1;
1571 kickptt(o);
1572 if (o->audiothread != AST_PTHREADT_NULL) {
1573 pthread_join(o->audiothread, NULL);
1574 o->audiothread = AST_PTHREADT_NULL;
1575 }
1576 if (o->hidthread != AST_PTHREADT_NULL) {
1577 pthread_join(o->hidthread, NULL);
1578 o->hidthread = AST_PTHREADT_NULL;
1579 }
1580 ast_channel_tech_pvt_set(c, NULL);
1581 o->owner = NULL;
1582 ast_module_unref(ast_module_info->self);
1583 if (o->hookstate) {
1584 o->hookstate = 0;
1585 }
1586 ast_radio_pa_stop(&o->pa);
1587
1588 return 0;
1589}
1590
1591URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int usbradio_write(struct ast_channel *c, struct ast_frame *f)
1592{
1593 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o = ast_channel_tech_pvt(c);
1594
1595 if (!o->hasusb || !o->audio_thread_ready) {
1596 return 0;
1597 }
1598
1599#if DEBUG_CAPTURES == 1
1600 /* Write input data to a file.
1601 * Left channel has the audio, right channel shows txkeyed
1602 */
1603 if (ftxcapraw && o->txcapraw) {
1604 short i, tbuff[f->datalen];
1605 memset(tbuff, 0, sizeof(tbuff));
1606 for (i = 0; i < f->datalen; i += 2) {
1607 tbuff[i] = ((short *)(f->data.ptr))[i / 2];
1608 tbuff[i + 1] = o->txkeyed * M_Q13;
1609 }
1610 fwrite(tbuff, 2, f->datalen, ftxcapraw);
1611 }
1612#endif
1613
1614 /* Preserve app_rpt's continuous stream, including idle silence, so PTT
1615 * transitions do not interrupt clock recovery. Echo owns the input while playing. */
1616 if (o->echoing || f->frametype != AST_FRAME_VOICE || !f->data.ptr) {
1617 return 0;
1618 }
1619 usbradioplus_queue_program(o, f->data.ptr, f->datalen / sizeof(short));
1620
1621 return 0;
1622}
1623
1624URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL struct ast_frame *usbradio_read(struct ast_channel *c)
1625{
1626 (void)c;
1627 ast_debug(1, "Read function should not be called!\n");
1628 return &ast_null_frame;
1629}
1630
1634URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL void stream_cleanup(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
1635{
1636 ast_radio_pa_stop(&o->pa);
1637 usbradio_swap_audio_stopped(o);
1638 o->audio_thread_ready = 0;
1639}
1640
1645URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL void *usbradio_audio_thread(void *arg)
1646{
1647 PaError pa_res;
1648 int lastpttout;
1649 int cd, sd;
1650 int was_rxkeyed;
1651 int tx_write_ready;
1652 long frames_available;
1653 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o = arg;
1654 struct ast_frame *f = &o->read_f, *f1;
1655 time_t now;
1656
1657 ast_debug(5, "Audio thread is starting\n");
1658 ast_radio_time(&o->lastaudiotime);
1659
1660 while (!o->stopaudiothread) {
1661 ast_radio_time(&o->lastaudiotime);
1662
1663 if (!o->hasusb) {
1664 usbradio_swap_audio_stopped(o);
1665 usleep(DEVICE_RETRY);
1666 continue;
1667 }
1668
1669 if (!o->pa.active && usbradio_start_audio(o) < 0) {
1670 usbradio_log_fault(o, 0, "Channel %s: Failed to start audio stream\n",
1671 o->name);
1672 o->hasusb = 0;
1673 usleep(DEVICE_RETRY);
1674 continue;
1675 }
1676
1677 /* Prime one silence frame so a late first wake-up does not underrun. */
1678 ast_radio_pa_write(&o->pa, silence_buf, AST_RADIO_PA_FRAMES_PER_BUFFER);
1679 o->audio_thread_ready = 1;
1680
1681 while (!o->stopaudiothread && o->hasusb) {
1682 if (o->lasthidtime) {
1683 ast_radio_time(&now);
1684 if ((now - o->lasthidtime) > 3) {
1685 usbradio_log_fault(o, 0,
1686 "Channel %s: HID process has died or is "
1687 "not responding.\n",
1688 o->name);
1689 o->hasusb = 0;
1690 stream_cleanup(o);
1691 break;
1692 }
1693 }
1694
1695 ast_radio_time(&o->lastaudiotime);
1696 memset(f, 0, sizeof(struct ast_frame));
1697 f->frametype = AST_FRAME_NULL;
1698 f->src = __PRETTY_FUNCTION__;
1699
1700 if (!o->hasusb) {
1701 if (o->rxkeyed) {
1702 struct ast_frame wf = {
1703 .frametype = AST_FRAME_CONTROL,
1704 .subclass.integer = AST_CONTROL_RADIO_UNKEY,
1705 .src = __PRETTY_FUNCTION__,
1706 };
1707
1708 o->lastrx = 0;
1709 o->rxkeyed = 0;
1710 if (o->owner) {
1711 ast_queue_frame(o->owner, &wf);
1712 }
1713 if (o->duplex3) {
1714 usbradio_set_sidetone_switch(o, 0);
1715 }
1716 }
1717 stream_cleanup(o);
1718 break;
1719 }
1720
1721 /* One PortAudio input block for loop pacing */
1722 pa_res = usbradio_read_pa_stereo(o);
1723 if (pa_res != paNoError) {
1724 if (pa_res == paTimedOut || pa_res == paInputOverflowed) {
1725 /* RX silence when no input block is available */
1726 memset(o->usbradio_read_buf + AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET, 0,
1727 sizeof(o->usbradio_read_buf) - AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET);
1728 } else {
1729 usbradio_log_fault(o, 0,
1730 "Channel %s: PortAudio read failed "
1731 "(%s); restarting audio stream\n",
1732 o->name, Pa_GetErrorText(pa_res));
1733 o->hasusb = 0;
1734 stream_cleanup(o);
1735 break;
1736 }
1737 }
1738
1739 /* If we have stopped echoing, clear the echo queue */
1740 if (!o->echomode) {
1741 ast_mutex_lock(&o->echolock);
1742 o->echoing = 0;
1743 while (o->echoq.q_forw != &o->echoq) {
1744 struct qelem *q = o->echoq.q_forw;
1745 remque(q);
1746 ast_free(q);
1747 }
1748 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->echolock);
1749 }
1750
1751 /* PortAudio output capacity check */
1752 frames_available = ast_radio_pa_write_available(&o->pa);
1753 if (frames_available < 0) {
1754 ast_debug(2, "Channel %s: Pa_GetStreamWriteAvailable error %s\n",
1755 o->name, Pa_GetErrorText(frames_available));
1756 o->usb_faulted = 1;
1757 o->hasusb = 0;
1758 stream_cleanup(o);
1759 break;
1760 }
1761 tx_write_ready = frames_available >= AST_RADIO_PA_FRAMES_PER_BUFFER;
1762
1763 /* Echo playback feeds the same native-rate program queue as app_rpt. */
1764 if (tx_write_ready && o->echomode && !usbradioplus_native_echo(o) &&
1765 (!o->rxkeyed)) {
1766 ast_mutex_lock(&o->echolock);
1767 if (o->echoq.q_forw != &o->echoq) {
1768 struct usbecho *u = (struct usbecho *)o->echoq.q_forw;
1769 remque((struct qelem *)u);
1770 usbradioplus_queue_program(o, u->data, FRAME_SIZE);
1771 ast_free(u);
1772 o->echoing = 1;
1773 } else {
1774 o->echoing = 0;
1775 }
1776 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->echolock);
1777 }
1778
1779#if DEBUG_CAPTURES == 1
1780 if (o->rxcapraw && frxcapraw) {
1781 fwrite(o->usbradio_read_buf + AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET, 1,
1782 AST_RADIO_PA_FRAMES_PER_BUFFER *
1783 AST_RADIO_PA_OUTPUT_CHANNELS * sizeof(short),
1784 frxcapraw);
1785 }
1786#endif
1787
1788 o->readerrs = 0;
1789 o->readpos = sizeof(o->usbradio_read_buf);
1790
1791 if (ast_radio_check_audio(
1792 (short *)(o->usbradio_read_buf + AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET),
1793 &o->rxaudiostats, AST_RADIO_PA_48K_STEREO_SAMPLES, 0)) {
1794 if (o->clipledgpio) {
1795 if (!o->hid_gpio_pulsetimer[o->clipledgpio - 1]) {
1796 o->hid_gpio_pulsetimer[o->clipledgpio - 1] =
1797 CLIP_LED_HOLD_TIME_MS;
1798 }
1799 }
1800 }
1801
1802 was_rxkeyed = o->rxkeyed;
1803 /* Only app_rpt and tuning own PTT. */
1804 if (o->txkeyed || o->txtestkey) {
1805 if (!o->radio->txPttIn) {
1806 o->radio->txPttIn = 1;
1807 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: txPttIn = %i.\n", o->name,
1808 o->radio->txPttIn);
1809 }
1810 } else if (o->radio->txPttIn) {
1811 o->radio->txPttIn = 0;
1812 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: txPttIn = %i.\n", o->name,
1813 o->radio->txPttIn);
1814 }
1815 lastpttout = o->radio->txPttOut;
1816
1817 usbradioplus_prepare_squelch_audio(o);
1818 urp_radio_process(o->radio, o->plus_squelch_native,
1819 (i16 *)(o->usbradio_read_buf_8k + AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET),
1820 o->usbradio_write_buf);
1821 usbradioplus_refresh_ctcss_decode(o);
1822 usbradioplus_native_tick(o);
1823
1824 if (lastpttout != o->radio->txPttOut) {
1825 usbradioplus_program_radio(o);
1826 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: txPttOut = %i.\n", o->name,
1827 o->radio->txPttOut);
1828 kickptt(o);
1829 }
1830
1831#if DEBUG_CAPTURES == 1 && URP_RADIO_DEBUG == 1
1832 if (o->txcap2 && ftxcaptrace) {
1833 fwrite((o->radio->ptxDebug), 1, FRAME_SIZE * 2 * 16, ftxcaptrace);
1834 }
1835#endif
1836
1837 /*
1838 * Write one frame when PortAudio has room. When unkeyed,
1839 * soundcard_writeframe() substitutes silence. Do not fill remaining
1840 * PortAudio room; that adds TX delay.
1841 */
1842 if (tx_write_ready) {
1843 if (!soundcard_writeframe(o, o->usbradio_write_buf)) {
1844 stream_cleanup(o);
1845 break;
1846 }
1847 ast_radio_check_audio(o->usbradio_write_buf, &o->txaudiostats,
1848 AST_RADIO_PA_48K_STEREO_SAMPLES, 0);
1849 }
1850
1851#if DEBUG_CAPTURES == 1 && URP_RADIO_DEBUG == 1
1852 if (frxcaptrace && o->rxcap2 && o->radioactive) {
1853 fwrite((o->radio->prxDebug), 1, FRAME_SIZE * 2 * 16, frxcaptrace);
1854 }
1855#endif
1856
1857 {
1858 enum radio_carrier_detect rxcdtype = effective_rxcdtype(o);
1859 cd = 0;
1860 if (rxcdtype == CD_HID &&
1861 (o->radio->rxExtCarrierDetect != o->rxhidsq)) {
1862 o->radio->rxExtCarrierDetect = o->rxhidsq;
1863 }
1864
1865 if (rxcdtype == CD_HID_INVERT &&
1866 (o->radio->rxExtCarrierDetect == o->rxhidsq)) {
1867 o->radio->rxExtCarrierDetect = !o->rxhidsq;
1868 }
1869
1870 if (usbradioplus_carrier_detected(o, rxcdtype)) {
1871 if (!o->radio->txPttOut || o->radioduplex) {
1872 cd = 1;
1873 }
1874 } else {
1875 cd = 0;
1876 }
1877
1878 if (cd != o->rxcarrierdetect) {
1879 o->rxcarrierdetect = cd;
1880 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: rxcarrierdetect = %i.\n", o->name,
1881 cd);
1882 }
1883 o->rx_cos_active = cd;
1884 }
1885
1886#ifndef HAVE_XPMRX
1887 if (usbradioplus_ctcss_detected(o)) {
1888 sd = 1;
1889 } else {
1890 sd = 0;
1891 }
1892#else
1893 if ((!o->radio->b.ctcssRxEnable && !o->radio->b.dcsRxEnable &&
1894 !o->radio->b.lmrRxEnable) ||
1895 (o->radio->b.ctcssRxEnable && o->radio->rxCtcss->decode > CTCSS_NULL &&
1896 o->radio->smode == SMODE_CTCSS) ||
1897 (o->radio->b.dcsRxEnable && o->radio->decDcs->decode > 0 &&
1898 o->radio->smode == SMODE_DCS)) {
1899 sd = 1;
1900 } else {
1901 sd = 0;
1902 }
1903
1904 if (o->radio->decDcs->decode != o->rxdcsdecode) {
1905 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: rxdcsdecode = %s.\n", o->name,
1906 o->radio->rxctcssfreq);
1907 o->rxdcsdecode = o->radio->decDcs->decode;
1908 ast_copy_string(o->rxctcssfreq, o->radio->rxctcssfreq,
1909 sizeof(o->rxctcssfreq));
1910 }
1911
1912 if (o->radio->rptnum &&
1913 (o->radio->pLsdCtl->cs[o->radio->rptnum].b.rxkeyed != o->rxlsddecode)) {
1914 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: rxLSDecode = %s.\n", o->name,
1915 o->radio->rxctcssfreq);
1916 o->rxlsddecode = o->radio->pLsdCtl->cs[o->radio->rptnum].b.rxkeyed;
1917 ast_copy_string(o->rxctcssfreq, o->radio->rxctcssfreq,
1918 sizeof(o->rxctcssfreq));
1919 }
1920
1921 if ((o->radio->rptnum > 0 && o->radio->smode == SMODE_LSD &&
1922 o->radio->pLsdCtl->cs[o->radio->rptnum].b.rxkeyed) ||
1923 (o->radio->smode == SMODE_DCS && o->radio->decDcs->decode > 0)) {
1924 sd = 1;
1925 }
1926#endif
1927 if (o->rxsdtype == SD_HID) {
1928 sd = o->rxhidctcss;
1929 } else if (o->rxsdtype == SD_HID_INVERT) {
1930 sd = !o->rxhidctcss;
1931 } else if (o->rxsdtype == SD_PP) {
1932 sd = o->rxppctcss;
1933 } else if (o->rxsdtype == SD_PP_INVERT) {
1934 sd = !o->rxppctcss;
1935 }
1936 if (o->rxctcssoverride) {
1937 sd = 1;
1938 }
1939 o->rx_ctcss_active = sd;
1940
1941 if (effective_rxcdtype(o) == CD_IGNORE && o->rxsdtype == SD_IGNORE) {
1942 cd = 0;
1943 sd = 0;
1944 }
1945
1946 if (o->txoffdelay) {
1947 if (o->txkeyed == 1) {
1948 o->txoffcnt = 0;
1949 } else {
1950 o->txoffcnt++;
1951 if (o->txoffcnt > MS_TO_FRAMES(TX_OFF_DELAY_MAX)) {
1952 o->txoffcnt = MS_TO_FRAMES(TX_OFF_DELAY_MAX);
1953 }
1954 }
1955 }
1956
1957 if (cd && sd) {
1958 if (!o->rxkeyed) {
1959 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: o->rxkeyed = 1.\n", o->name);
1960 }
1961 if (o->rxkeyed || ((o->txoffcnt >= o->txoffdelay) &&
1962 (o->rxoncnt >= o->rxondelay))) {
1963 o->rxkeyed = 1;
1964 } else {
1965 o->rxoncnt++;
1966 }
1967 } else {
1968 if (o->rxkeyed) {
1969 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: o->rxkeyed = 0.\n", o->name);
1970 }
1971 o->rxkeyed = 0;
1972 o->rxoncnt = 0;
1973 }
1974 if (o->echomode && usbradioplus_native_echo(o)) {
1975 usbradioplus_parrot_rx_transition(o, was_rxkeyed);
1976 }
1977
1978 if (o->echomode && !usbradioplus_native_echo(o) && o->rxkeyed &&
1979 (!o->echoing)) {
1980 register int x;
1981 struct usbecho *u;
1982
1983 ast_mutex_lock(&o->echolock);
1984 x = 0;
1985 for (u = (struct usbecho *)o->echoq.q_forw;
1986 u != (struct usbecho *)&o->echoq;
1987 u = (struct usbecho *)u->q_forw) {
1988 x++;
1989 }
1990 if (x < o->echomax) {
1991 u = ast_calloc(1, sizeof(struct usbecho));
1992 if (u) {
1993 memcpy(u->data,
1994 (o->usbradio_read_buf_8k +
1995 AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET),
1996 FRAME_SIZE * 2);
1997 insque((struct qelem *)u, o->echoq.q_back);
1998 }
1999 }
2000 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->echolock);
2001 }
2002
2003 if (o->lastrx && (!o->rxkeyed)) {
2004 struct ast_frame wf = {
2005 .frametype = AST_FRAME_CONTROL,
2006 .subclass.integer = AST_CONTROL_RADIO_UNKEY,
2007 .src = __PRETTY_FUNCTION__,
2008 };
2009
2010 o->lastrx = 0;
2011 if (o->owner) {
2012 ast_queue_frame(o->owner, &wf);
2013 }
2014 if (o->duplex3 && o->duplex3mode == DUPLEX3_MODE_HARDWARE) {
2015 usbradio_set_sidetone_switch(o, 0);
2016 }
2017 } else if ((!o->lastrx) && (o->rxkeyed)) {
2018 struct ast_frame wf = {
2019 .frametype = AST_FRAME_CONTROL,
2020 .subclass.integer = AST_CONTROL_RADIO_KEY,
2021 .src = __PRETTY_FUNCTION__,
2022 };
2023
2024 o->lastrx = 1;
2025 if (o->rxctcssdecode) {
2026 wf.data.ptr = o->rxctcssfreq;
2027 wf.datalen = strlen(o->rxctcssfreq) + 1;
2028 ast_debug(7, "Radio Key - CTCSS frequency=%s.\n",
2029 o->rxctcssfreq);
2030 }
2031 if (o->owner) {
2032 ast_queue_frame(o->owner, &wf);
2033 }
2034 o->count_rssi_update = 1;
2035 if (o->duplex3 && o->duplex3mode == DUPLEX3_MODE_HARDWARE) {
2036 usbradio_set_sidetone_switch(o, 1);
2037 }
2038 }
2039
2040 o->readpos = AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET;
2041 if (!o->owner || ast_channel_state(o->owner) != AST_STATE_UP) {
2042 continue;
2043 }
2044
2045 f->frametype = AST_FRAME_VOICE;
2046 f->subclass.format = ast_format_slin;
2047 f->offset = AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET;
2048 f->samples = o->plus_app_rpt_samples;
2049 f->datalen = f->samples * sizeof(short);
2050 f->data.ptr = o->usbradio_read_buf_8k + AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET;
2051 f->src = __PRETTY_FUNCTION__;
2052 if (!o->rxkeyed) {
2053 memset(f->data.ptr, 0, f->datalen);
2054 }
2055
2056 if (o->usedtmf && o->dsp) {
2057 f1 = ast_dsp_process(o->owner, o->dsp, f);
2058 if ((f1->frametype == AST_FRAME_DTMF_END) ||
2059 (f1->frametype == AST_FRAME_DTMF_BEGIN)) {
2060 if ((f1->subclass.integer == 'm') ||
2061 (f1->subclass.integer == 'u')) {
2062 f1->frametype = AST_FRAME_NULL;
2063 f1->subclass.integer = 0;
2064 ast_queue_frame(o->owner, f1);
2065 continue;
2066 }
2067 if (f1->frametype == AST_FRAME_DTMF_END) {
2068 f1->len = ast_tvdiff_ms(ast_radio_tvnow(),
2069 o->tonetime);
2070 if (option_verbose) {
2071 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE,
2072 "Channel %s: Got DTMF char %c "
2073 "duration %ld ms\n",
2074 o->name, f1->subclass.integer,
2075 f1->len);
2076 }
2077 o->toneflag = 0;
2078 } else {
2079 if (o->toneflag) {
2080 ast_frfree(f1);
2081 f1 = NULL;
2082 } else {
2083 o->tonetime = ast_radio_tvnow();
2084 o->toneflag = 1;
2085 }
2086 }
2087 if (f1) {
2088 ast_queue_frame(o->owner, f1);
2089 continue;
2090 }
2091 }
2092 }
2093
2094 if (o->radio->b.txCtcssReady) {
2095 struct ast_frame wf = {
2096 .frametype = AST_FRAME_TEXT,
2097 .src = __PRETTY_FUNCTION__,
2098 };
2099 char msg[32];
2100
2101 snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "cstx=%.26s", o->radio->txctcssfreq);
2102 wf.data.ptr = msg;
2103 wf.datalen = strlen(msg) + 1;
2104 ast_queue_frame(o->owner, &wf);
2105
2106 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: got b.txCtcssReady %s.\n", o->name,
2107 o->radio->txctcssfreq);
2108 o->radio->b.txCtcssReady = 0;
2109 }
2110
2111 if (o->sendvoter && o->count_rssi_update && o->rxkeyed) {
2112 if (--o->count_rssi_update <= 0) {
2113 struct ast_frame wf = {
2114 .frametype = AST_FRAME_TEXT,
2115 .src = __PRETTY_FUNCTION__,
2116 };
2117 char msg[32];
2118
2119 snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "R %i",
2120 ((32767 - o->radio->rxRssi) * 1000) / 32767);
2121 wf.data.ptr = msg;
2122 wf.datalen = strlen(msg) + 1;
2123 ast_queue_frame(o->owner, &wf);
2124
2125 o->count_rssi_update = 10;
2126 ast_debug(4, "Channel %s: Count_rssi_update %i\n", o->name,
2127 ((32767 - o->radio->rxRssi) * 1000 / 32767));
2128 }
2129 }
2130
2131 ast_queue_frame(o->owner, f);
2132 }
2133 stream_cleanup(o);
2134 }
2135
2136 stream_cleanup(o);
2137 ast_debug(2, "Audio thread has exited\n");
2138 return NULL;
2139}
2140
2141URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL struct ast_channel *usbradio_new(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, char *ext,
2142 char *ctx, int state,
2143 const struct ast_assigned_ids *assignedids,
2144 const struct ast_channel *requestor)
2145{
2146 struct ast_channel *c;
2147
2148 c = ast_channel_alloc(1, state, NULL, NULL, "", ext, ctx, assignedids, requestor, 0,
2149 "RadioPlus/%s", o->name);
2150 if (c == NULL) {
2151 return NULL;
2152 }
2153 ast_channel_tech_set(c, &usbradio_tech);
2154 ast_channel_nativeformats_set(c, usbradio_tech.capabilities);
2155 ast_channel_set_readformat(c, ast_format_slin);
2156 ast_channel_set_writeformat(c, ast_format_slin);
2157 ast_channel_tech_pvt_set(c, o);
2158 o->owner = c;
2159 ast_channel_unlock(c);
2160 ast_module_ref(ast_module_info->self);
2161 ast_jb_configure(c, &global_jbconf);
2162 if (state != AST_STATE_DOWN) {
2163 if (ast_pbx_start(c)) {
2164 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "Channel %s: Unable to start PBX.\n",
2165 ast_channel_name(c));
2166 ast_hangup(c);
2167 o->owner = c = NULL;
2168 /* XXX what about the channel itself ? */
2169 }
2170 }
2171
2172 return c;
2173}
2174
2175URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL struct ast_channel *usbradio_request(const char *type, struct ast_format_cap *cap,
2176 const struct ast_assigned_ids *assignedids,
2177 const struct ast_channel *requestor,
2178 const char *data, int *cause)
2179{
2180 (void)type;
2181 struct ast_channel *c;
2182 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o = find_desc(data);
2183
2184 if (!o) {
2185 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "Device %s not found.\n", (char *)data);
2186 return NULL;
2187 }
2188
2189 if (!(ast_format_cap_iscompatible(cap, usbradio_tech.capabilities))) {
2190 struct ast_str *cap_buf = ast_str_alloca(AST_FORMAT_CAP_NAMES_LEN);
2191 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE,
2192 "Channel %s: Channel requested with unsupported format(s): '%s'\n", o->name,
2193 ast_format_cap_get_names(cap, &cap_buf));
2194 return NULL;
2195 }
2196
2197 if (o->owner) {
2198 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE,
2199 "Channel %s: Already have a call (chan %p) on the usb channel\n", o->name,
2200 o->owner);
2201 *cause = AST_CAUSE_BUSY;
2202 return NULL;
2203 }
2204 c = usbradio_new(o, NULL, NULL, AST_STATE_DOWN, assignedids, requestor);
2205 if (!c) {
2206 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Channel %s: Unable to create new usb channel\n", o->name);
2207 return NULL;
2208 }
2209
2210 o->remoted = 0;
2211 radio_config(o);
2212
2213 return c;
2214}

2216URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int radio_active(int fd, int argc, const char *const *argv)
2217{
2218 if (argc == 2) {
2219 ast_cli(fd, "Active USB Radio device is [%s].\n", usbradio_active);
2220 } else if (argc != 3) {
2221 return RESULT_SHOWUSAGE;
2222 } else {
2223 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o;
2224 if (!strcmp(argv[2], "show")) {
2225 for (o = usbradio_default.next; o; o = o->next) {
2226 char devstr[sizeof(o->devstr)];
2227 int alsa_card;
2228
2229 usbradio_device_identity(o, devstr, sizeof(devstr), NULL, 0,
2230 &alsa_card);
2231 ast_cli(fd, "Device [%s] is assigned to device=%s card=%d\n",
2232 o->name, ast_strlen_zero(devstr) ? "unassigned" : devstr,
2233 alsa_card);
2234 }
2235 return RESULT_SUCCESS;
2236 }
2237 o = find_desc(argv[2]);
2238 if (!o) {
2239 ast_cli(fd, "No device [%s] exists\n", argv[2]);
2240 } else {
2241 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *ao;
2242 for (ao = usbradio_default.next; ao; ao = ao->next) {
2243 ao->radioactive = 0;
2244 }
2245 usbradio_active = o->name;
2246 o->radioactive = 1;
2247 ast_cli(fd, "Active (command) USB Radio device set to [%s]\n",
2248 usbradio_active);
2249 }
2250 }
2251 return RESULT_SUCCESS;
2252}
2253
2254int usb_device_swap(int fd, const char *other)
2255{
2256 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *p, *o;
2257 int attempts;
2258 int result;
2259
2260 if (!other) {
2261 return -1;
2262 }
2263 o = find_desc(usbradio_active);
2264 if (o == NULL) {
2265 return -1;
2266 }
2267 p = find_desc(other);
2268 if (p == NULL) {
2269 ast_cli(fd, "USB Device %s not found\n", other);
2270 return -1;
2271 }
2272 if (p == o) {
2273 ast_cli(fd, "You can't swap active device with itself!!\n");
2274 return -1;
2275 }
2276
2277 /* Serialize the complete device swap transaction */
2278 ast_mutex_lock(&device_swap_lock);
2279 if (!o->hasusb || !p->hasusb) {
2280 ast_cli(fd, "Both channels must have assigned USB devices before they can be "
2281 "swapped.\n");
2282 ast_mutex_unlock(&device_swap_lock);
2283 return -1;
2284 }
2285
2286 /* Stop both device handles while retaining their shared leases */
2287 usbradio_swap_begin(o);
2288 usbradio_swap_begin(p);
2289 o->hasusb = 0;
2290 p->hasusb = 0;
2291 kickptt(o);
2292 kickptt(p);
2293
2294 /* Wait for the HID and PortAudio handles to close */
2295 for (attempts = 0; attempts < 500; attempts++) {
2296 if (usbradio_swap_ready(o) && usbradio_swap_ready(p)) {
2297 break;
2298 }
2299 usleep(10000);
2300 }
2301 if (attempts == 500) {
2302 usbradio_swap_finish(o);
2303 usbradio_swap_finish(p);
2304 ast_cli(fd, "Timed out waiting for both USB devices to stop.\n");
2305 ast_mutex_unlock(&device_swap_lock);
2306 return -1;
2307 }
2308
2309 /* Exchange the parked leases and use their identities for future requests */
2310 ast_mutex_lock(&o->device_lock);
2311 ast_mutex_lock(&p->device_lock);
2312 result = ast_radio_device_swap(&o->radio_device, &p->radio_device);
2313 if (!result) {
2314 ast_copy_string(o->devstr, o->radio_device->devstr, sizeof(o->devstr));
2315 ast_copy_string(o->serial, S_OR(o->radio_device->serial, ""), sizeof(o->serial));
2316 ast_copy_string(p->devstr, p->radio_device->devstr, sizeof(p->devstr));
2317 ast_copy_string(p->serial, S_OR(p->radio_device->serial, ""), sizeof(p->serial));
2318 }
2319 ast_mutex_unlock(&p->device_lock);
2320 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->device_lock);
2321 usbradio_swap_finish(o);
2322 usbradio_swap_finish(p);
2323
2324 if (result) {
2325 ast_cli(fd, "Unable to exchange USB device leases.\n");
2326 ast_mutex_unlock(&device_swap_lock);
2327 return -1;
2328 }
2329 ast_cli(fd, "USB Devices successfully swapped.\n");
2330 ast_mutex_unlock(&device_swap_lock);
2331 return 0;
2332}
2333
2334void tune_rxinput(int fd, struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, int setsql, int intflag)
2335{
2336 const int settingmin = 1;
2337 const int settingstart = 2;
2338 const int maxtries = 12;
2339
2340 int target;
2341 int tolerance = 2750;
2342 int setting = 0, tries = 0, tmpdiscfactor, meas, measnoise;
2343 unsigned int rms = 0;
2344 double peak_dbfs, rms_dbfs;
2345 int micmax, spkrmax, micplaymax;
2346 float settingmax, f;
2347
2348 if (o->rxdemod == RX_AUDIO_SPEAKER && o->rxcdtype == CD_XPMR_NOISE) {
2349 ast_cli(fd, "ERROR: usbradioplus.conf rxdemod=speaker vs. carrierfrom=dsp \n");
2350 }
2351
2352 if (o->rxdemod == RX_AUDIO_FLAT) {
2353 target = 27000;
2354 } else {
2355 target = 23000;
2356 }
2357
2358 usbradio_mixer_limits(o, &micmax, &spkrmax, &micplaymax);
2359 if (micmax <= 0) {
2360 ast_cli(fd, "ERROR: RX mixer is unavailable.\n");
2361 return;
2362 }
2363 settingmax = micmax;
2364
2365 o->fever = 1;
2366 o->radio->fever = 1;
2367
2368 o->radio->b.tuning = 1;
2369
2370 setting = settingstart;
2371
2372 ast_cli(fd, "tune rxnoise maxtries=%i, target=%i, tolerance=%i\n", maxtries, target,
2373 tolerance);
2374
2375 while (tries < maxtries) {
2376 usbradio_set_rx_mixer(o, setting);
2377
2378 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 100, intflag)) {
2379 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
2380 return;
2381 }
2382 o->radio->spsMeasure->source = o->radio->spsRx->source;
2383 o->radio->spsMeasure->discfactor = 2000;
2384 o->radio->spsMeasure->enabled = 1;
2385 o->radio->spsMeasure->amax = o->radio->spsMeasure->amin = 0;
2386 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 400, intflag)) {
2387 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
2388 return;
2389 }
2390 meas = o->radio->spsMeasure->apeak;
2391 o->radio->spsMeasure->enabled = 0;
2392
2393 if (!meas) {
2394 meas++;
2395 }
2396 unsigned int stats_index =
2397 (o->rxaudiostats.index + AUDIO_STATS_LEN - 1) % AUDIO_STATS_LEN;
2398 rms = (unsigned int)(sqrt((double)o->rxaudiostats.pwrbuf[stats_index]) + 0.5);
2399 peak_dbfs = 20.0 * log10((double)meas / 32768.0);
2400 rms_dbfs = rms ? 20.0 * log10((double)rms / 32768.0) : -96.0;
2401 ast_cli(fd, "tries=%i, setting=%i, Peak=%i (%.1f dBFS), RMS=%u (%.1f dBFS)\n",
2402 tries, setting, meas, peak_dbfs, rms, rms_dbfs);
2403
2404 if ((meas < (target - tolerance) || meas > (target + tolerance)) && tries <= 2) {
2405 f = (float)(setting * target) / meas;
2406 setting = (int)(f + 0.5);
2407 } else if (meas < (target - tolerance)) {
2408 setting++;
2409 } else if (meas > (target + tolerance)) {
2410 setting--;
2411 } else if (tries > 5) {
2412 break;
2413 }
2414
2415 if (setting < settingmin) {
2416 setting = settingmin;
2417 } else if (setting > settingmax) {
2418 setting = settingmax;
2419 }
2420 tries++;
2421 }
2422
2423 /* Measure HF Noise */
2424 tmpdiscfactor = o->radio->spsRx->discfactor;
2425 o->radio->spsRx->discfactor = (i16)2000;
2426 o->radio->spsRx->discounteru = o->radio->spsRx->discounterl = 0;
2427 o->radio->spsRx->amax = o->radio->spsRx->amin = 0;
2428 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 200, intflag)) {
2429 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
2430 return;
2431 }
2432 measnoise = o->radio->rxRssi;
2433
2434 /* Measure RSSI */
2435 o->radio->spsRx->discfactor = tmpdiscfactor;
2436 o->radio->spsRx->discounteru = o->radio->spsRx->discounterl = 0;
2437 o->radio->spsRx->amax = o->radio->spsRx->amin = 0;
2438 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 200, intflag)) {
2439 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
2440 return;
2441 }
2442
2443 ast_cli(fd,
2444 "DONE tries=%i, setting=%i, Peak=%i (%.1f dBFS), RMS=%u (%.1f dBFS), sqnoise=%i\n",
2445 tries, ((setting * 1000) + (micmax / 2)) / micmax, meas, peak_dbfs, rms, rms_dbfs,
2446 measnoise);
2447
2448 if (meas < target - tolerance || meas > target + tolerance) {
2449 ast_cli(fd, "ERROR: RX INPUT ADJUST FAILED.\n");
2450 } else {
2451 ast_cli(fd, "INFO: RX INPUT ADJUST SUCCESS.\n");
2452 setting = ((setting * 1000) + (micmax / 2)) / micmax;
2453 usbradioplus_processing_set_hardware_input_gain(o->name,
2454 urp_mixer_to_gain_db(setting));
2455
2456 if (o->rxcdtype == CD_XPMR_NOISE) {
2457 int normRssi = ((32767 - o->radio->rxRssi) * AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT / 32767);
2458
2459 if ((meas / (measnoise / 10)) > 26) {
2460 ast_cli(fd, "WARNING: Insufficient high frequency noise from "
2461 "receiver.\n");
2462 ast_cli(fd, "WARNING: Rx input point may be de-emphasized and not "
2463 "flat.\n");
2464 ast_cli(fd, " usbradioplus.conf setting of "
2465 "'carrierfrom=dsp' not recommended.\n");
2466 } else {
2467 ast_cli(fd, "Rx noise input seems sufficient for squelch.\n");
2468 }
2469 if (setsql) {
2470 o->rxsquelchadj = normRssi + 150;
2471 if (o->rxsquelchadj > 999) {
2472 o->rxsquelchadj = 999;
2473 }
2474 *(o->radio->prxSquelchAdjust) =
2475 ((999 - o->rxsquelchadj) * 32767) / AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT;
2476 ast_cli(fd, "Rx Squelch set to %d (RSSI=%d).\n", o->rxsquelchadj,
2477 normRssi);
2478 } else {
2479 if (o->rxsquelchadj < normRssi) {
2480 ast_cli(fd,
2481 "WARNING: RSSI=%i SQUELCH=%i and is set too "
2482 "loose.\n",
2483 normRssi, o->rxsquelchadj);
2484 ast_cli(fd,
2485 " Use 'radio tune rxsquelch' to adjust.\n");
2486 }
2487 }
2488 }
2489 }
2490 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
2491}
2492
2493void _menu_rxvoice(int fd, struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, const char *str)
2494{
2495 int i;
2496 int micmax, spkrmax, micplaymax;
2497 float f, f1;
2498
2499 if (!str[0]) {
2500 if (o->rxdemod == RX_AUDIO_FLAT) {
2501 ast_cli(fd, "Current Rx voice setting: %d\n",
2502 (int)((effective_rx_decoder_gain(o) * 200.0) + .5));
2503 } else {
2504 ast_cli(fd, "Current Rx voice setting: %d\n", effective_rxmixerset(o));
2505 }
2506 return;
2507 }
2508 if (parse_tune_level(str, &i)) {
2509 ast_cli(fd, "Entry Error, Rx voice setting not changed\n");
2510 return;
2511 }
2512 if (o->rxdemod == RX_AUDIO_FLAT) {
2513 f = (float)i / 200.0;
2514 } else {
2515 usbradio_mixer_limits(o, &micmax, &spkrmax, &micplaymax);
2516 if (micmax <= 0) {
2517 ast_cli(fd, "RX mixer is unavailable.\n");
2518 return;
2519 }
2520 usbradioplus_processing_set_hardware_input_gain(o->name, urp_mixer_to_gain_db(i));
2521 /* adjust settings based on the device */
2522 int adjustment = effective_rxmixerset(o) * micmax / AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT;
2523 /* get interval step size */
2524 f = AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT / (float)micmax;
2525
2526 usbradio_set_rx_mixer(o, adjustment);
2527 f = 0.5 + (modff(((float)i) / f, &f1) * .093981);
2528 }
2529 usbradioplus_processing_set_local_input_gain(o->name,
2530 20.0 * log10(fmax(0.000001, 2.0 * f)));
2531 *(o->radio->prxVoiceAdjust) = f * M_Q8;
2532 ast_cli(fd, "Changed rx voice setting to %d\n", i);
2533}
2534
2535void _menu_print(int fd, struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
2536{
2537 char devstr[sizeof(o->devstr)];
2538 char serial[sizeof(o->serial)];
2539 int alsa_card;
2540
2541 usbradio_device_identity(o, devstr, sizeof(devstr), serial, sizeof(serial), &alsa_card);
2542 ast_cli(fd, "Active radio interface is [%s]\n", usbradio_active);
2543 ast_cli(fd, "Device String is %s\n", ast_strlen_zero(devstr) ? "unassigned" : devstr);
2544 if (!ast_strlen_zero(serial)) {
2545 ast_cli(fd, "Device Serial is %s\n", serial);
2546 }
2547 ast_cli(fd, "Card is %i\n", alsa_card);
2548 ast_cli(fd, "Output A is currently set to ");
2549 if (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_COMPOSITE) {
2550 ast_cli(fd, "composite.\n");
2551 } else if (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_VOICE) {
2552 ast_cli(fd, "voice.\n");
2553 } else if (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_LSD) {
2554 ast_cli(fd, "tone.\n");
2555 } else if (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_AUX) {
2556 ast_cli(fd, "auxvoice.\n");
2557 } else {
2558 ast_cli(fd, "off.\n");
2559 }
2560
2561 ast_cli(fd, "Output B is currently set to ");
2562 if (o->txmixb == TX_OUT_COMPOSITE) {
2563 ast_cli(fd, "composite.\n");
2564 } else if (o->txmixb == TX_OUT_VOICE) {
2565 ast_cli(fd, "voice.\n");
2566 } else if (o->txmixb == TX_OUT_LSD) {
2567 ast_cli(fd, "tone.\n");
2568 } else if (o->txmixb == TX_OUT_AUX) {
2569 ast_cli(fd, "auxvoice.\n");
2570 } else {
2571 ast_cli(fd, "off.\n");
2572 }
2573
2574 if (o->rxdemod == RX_AUDIO_FLAT) {
2575 ast_cli(fd, "Rx Level currently set to %d\n",
2576 (int)((effective_rx_decoder_gain(o) * 200.0) + .5));
2577 } else {
2578 ast_cli(fd, "Rx Level currently set to %d\n", effective_rxmixerset(o));
2579 }
2580 ast_cli(fd, "Rx Squelch currently set to %d\n", o->rxsquelchadj);
2581 ast_cli(fd, "Tx Voice Level currently set to %d\n", o->txmixaset);
2582 ast_cli(fd, "Tx Tone Level currently set to %d\n", o->txctcssadj);
2583}

2591void tune_write(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
2592{
2593 const float old_rxctcssadj = 0.5; /* for backward EEPROM format compatibility */
2594 if (save_tuning_config(o))
2595 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "Failed to save tuning settings for %s\n", o->name);
2596
2597 if (o->wanteeprom) {
2598 ast_mutex_lock(&o->eepromlock);
2599 usbradioplus_wait_for_eeprom_idle(o);
2600 memset(o->eeprom, 0, sizeof(o->eeprom));
2601 o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_RXMIXERSET] = effective_rxmixerset(o);
2602 o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_TXMIXASET] = o->txmixaset;
2603 o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_TXMIXBSET] = o->txmixbset;
2604 memcpy(&o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_RXCTCSSADJ], &old_rxctcssadj, sizeof(float));
2605 o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_TXCTCSSADJ] = o->txctcssadj;
2606 o->eeprom[EEPROM_USER_RXSQUELCHADJ] = o->rxsquelchadj;
2607 o->eepromctl = 2; /* request a write */
2608 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->eepromlock);
2609 }
2610}
2611
2612void mixer_write(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
2613{
2614 const struct ast_radio_mixer_element *element;
2615 struct ast_radio_device *device;
2616 int requested;
2617 long sidetone_max;
2618 size_t path_index;
2619
2620 ast_mutex_lock(&o->device_lock);
2621 device = o->radio_device;
2622 if (!device) {
2623 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->device_lock);
2624 return;
2625 }
2626
2627 /* Hardware duplex-3 uses the portable 0--999 setting on every CM119. */
2628 sidetone_max = ast_radio_device_mixer_max(device, device->mixer_sidetone_paths,
2629 AST_RADIO_MIXER_PLAYBACK_VOLUME);
2630 ast_radio_device_set_mixer_paths(
2631 device, device->mixer_sidetone_paths, device->mixer_sidetone_path_count,
2632 AST_RADIO_MIXER_PLAYBACK_VOLUME,
2633 o->duplex3mode == DUPLEX3_MODE_HARDWARE
2634 ? (o->duplex3 * sidetone_max + DUPLEX3_LEVEL_MAX / 2) / DUPLEX3_LEVEL_MAX
2635 : 0);
2636 ast_radio_device_set_mixer_paths(device, device->mixer_sidetone_paths,
2637 device->mixer_sidetone_path_count,
2638 AST_RADIO_MIXER_PLAYBACK_SWITCH, 0);
2639
2640 /* Transmitter output paths (Speaker/Headphone controls on CM108)
2641 * txmixaset (MIXA) controls mixer_tx_paths[0], and txmixbset (MIXB) controls
2642 * mixer_tx_paths[1] when a second path is present. Additional paths are unchanged.
2643 */
2644 for (path_index = 0; path_index < device->mixer_tx_path_count && path_index < 2;
2645 path_index++) {
2646 element =
2647 ast_radio_device_mixer_element(device, &device->mixer_tx_paths[path_index]);
2648 if (!element) {
2649 continue;
2650 }
2651 requested = path_index ? effective_txmixbset(o) : effective_txmixaset(o);
2652 ast_radio_device_set_mixer(device, &device->mixer_tx_paths[path_index],
2653 AST_RADIO_MIXER_PLAYBACK_SWITCH, 1);
2654 ast_radio_device_set_mixer(
2655 device, &device->mixer_tx_paths[path_index],
2656 AST_RADIO_MIXER_PLAYBACK_VOLUME,
2657 ast_radio_device_mixer_scale(device, &device->mixer_tx_paths[path_index],
2658 AST_RADIO_MIXER_PLAYBACK_VOLUME, requested));
2659 }
2660
2661 /* adjust settings based on the device */
2662
2663 /* Receiver input paths (Mic Capture controls on CM108) */
2664 for (path_index = 0; path_index < device->mixer_rx_path_count; path_index++) {
2665 element =
2666 ast_radio_device_mixer_element(device, &device->mixer_rx_paths[path_index]);
2667 if (!element) {
2668 continue;
2669 }
2670 ast_radio_device_set_mixer(
2671 device, &device->mixer_rx_paths[path_index], AST_RADIO_MIXER_CAPTURE_VOLUME,
2672 ast_radio_device_mixer_scale(device, &device->mixer_rx_paths[path_index],
2673 AST_RADIO_MIXER_CAPTURE_VOLUME,
2674 effective_rxmixerset(o)));
2675 ast_radio_device_set_mixer(device, &device->mixer_rx_paths[path_index],
2676 AST_RADIO_MIXER_CAPTURE_SWITCH, 1);
2677 }
2678
2679 /* Optional receiver input gain/AGC paths */
2680 ast_radio_device_set_mixer_paths(device, device->mixer_rx_boost_paths,
2681 device->mixer_rx_boost_path_count,
2682 AST_RADIO_MIXER_PLAYBACK_SWITCH, 1);
2683 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->device_lock);
2684}

2708 }

2710void radio_dump(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, int fd)
2711{
2712 urp_radio_state *p;
2713 int i;
2714 int micmax, spkrmax, micplaymax;
2715
2716 p = o->radio;
2717
2718 ast_cli(fd, "\nodump()\n");
2719
2720 /* Acquired device identity */
2721 ast_mutex_lock(&o->device_lock);
2722 if (o->radio_device) {
2723 ast_cli(fd, "radio_device->devstr = %s\n", o->radio_device->devstr);
2724 ast_cli(fd, "radio_device->alsa_card = %d\n", o->radio_device->alsa_card);
2725 }
2726 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->device_lock);
2727
2728 usbradio_mixer_limits(o, &micmax, &spkrmax, &micplaymax);
2729 pd(micmax);
2730 pd(spkrmax);
2731
2732 pd(o->rxdemod);
2733 pd(o->rxcdtype);
2734 if (o->rxcdtype == CD_XPMR_VOX) {
2735 pd(o->voxhangtime);
2736 }
2737 pd(o->rxsdtype);
2738 pd(o->txtoctype);
2739
2740 ast_cli(fd, "rx mixer = %d\n", effective_rxmixerset(o));
2741
2742 ast_cli(fd, "rx input gain = %.3f dB\n", effective_rx_input_gain_db(o));
2743 pd(o->rxsquelchadj);
2744
2745 ps(o->txctcssdefault);
2746 ps(o->txctcssfreq);
2747
2748 pd(o->numrxctcssfreqs);
2749 pd(o->numtxctcssfreqs);
2750 if (o->numrxctcssfreqs > 0) {
2751 for (i = 0; i < o->numrxctcssfreqs; i++) {
2752 ast_cli(fd, " %i = %s %s\n", i, o->rxctcss[i], o->txctcss[i]);
2753 }
2754 }
2755 pd(o->rxpolarity);
2756 pd(o->txpolarity);
2757
2758 pd(o->txpreemphasis);
2759 pd(o->txmixa);
2760 pd(o->txmixb);
2761
2762 pd(o->txmixaset);
2763 pd(o->txmixbset);
2764
2765 ast_cli(fd, "\nnative radio state\n");
2766
2767 ast_cli(fd, "prxSquelchAdjust=%i\n", *(o->radio->prxSquelchAdjust));
2768
2769 pd(p->rxCarrierPoint);
2770 pd(p->rxCarrierHyst);
2771
2772 pd(*p->prxVoiceAdjust);
2773 pd(*p->prxCtcssAdjust);
2774
2775 pd(o->rxfreq);
2776 pd(o->txfreq);
2777
2778 pd(p->rxCtcss->relax);
2779 pd(p->numrxcodes);
2780 if (o->radio->numrxcodes > 0) {
2781 for (i = 0; i < o->radio->numrxcodes; i++) {
2782 ast_cli(fd, " %i = %s\n", i, o->radio->pRxCode[i]);
2783 }
2784 }
2785
2786 pd(p->txTocType);
2787 ps(p->pTxCodeDefault);
2788 pd(p->txcodedefaultsmode);
2789 pd(p->numtxcodes);
2790 if (o->radio->numtxcodes > 0) {
2791 for (i = 0; i < o->radio->numtxcodes; i++) {
2792 ast_cli(fd, " %i = %s\n", i, o->radio->pTxCode[i]);
2793 }
2794 }
2795
2796 pd(p->b.rxpolarity);
2797 pd(p->b.txpolarity);
2798 pd(p->b.dcsrxpolarity);
2799 pd(p->b.dcstxpolarity);
2800 pd(p->b.lsdrxpolarity);
2801 pd(p->b.lsdtxpolarity);
2802
2803 pd(p->txMixA);
2804 pd(p->txMixB);
2805
2806 pd(p->rxDeEmpEnable);
2807 pd(p->rxCenterSlicerEnable);
2808 pd(p->rxCtcssDecodeEnable);
2809 pd(p->rxDcsDecodeEnable);
2810 pd(p->b.ctcssRxEnable);
2811 pd(p->b.dcsRxEnable);
2812 pd(p->b.lmrRxEnable);
2813 pd(p->b.dstRxEnable);
2814 pd(p->smode);
2815
2816 pd(p->txOutputGainA);
2817 pd(p->txOutputGainB);
2818 pd(p->txPttIn);
2819 pd(p->txPttOut);
2820
2821 pd(p->tracetype);
2822 pd(p->b.txCtcssOff);
2823}

2825/*
2826 takes data from a chan_usbradio_pvt struct (e.g. o->)
2827 and configures the native radio detector
2828*/
2829
2830struct chan_usbradio_pvt *store_config(const char *ctg)
2831{
2832 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o;
2833 int i;
2834
2835 if (ctg == NULL) {
2836 o = &usbradio_default;
2837 ctg = "general";
2838 } else {
2839 /* "general" is also the default thing */
2840 if (strcmp(ctg, "general") == 0) {
2841 o = &usbradio_default;
2842 } else {
2843 if (!(o = ast_calloc(1, sizeof(*o)))) {
2844 return NULL;
2845 }
2846 *o = usbradio_default;
2847 o->name = ast_strdup(ctg);
2848 if (!o->name) {
2849 ast_free(o);
2850 return NULL;
2851 }
2852 o->pttkick[0] = -1;
2853 o->pttkick[1] = -1;
2854 o->hidthread = AST_PTHREADT_NULL;
2855 o->audiothread = AST_PTHREADT_NULL;
2856 if (!usbradio_active) {
2857 usbradio_active = o->name;
2858 }
2859 }
2860 }
2861 o->echoq.q_forw = o->echoq.q_back = &o->echoq;
2862 ast_mutex_init(&o->echolock);
2863 ast_mutex_init(&o->eepromlock);
2864 ast_mutex_init(&o->usblock);
2865 ast_mutex_init(&o->device_lock);
2866 ast_mutex_init(&o->swap_lock);
2867 ast_mutex_init(&o->plus_link_lock);
2868 o->echomax = DEFAULT_ECHO_MAX;
2869 if (o == &usbradio_default) {
2870 return NULL;
2871 }
2872 if (apply_processing_config_overrides(o, ctg)) {
2873 destroy_unlinked_channel(o);
2874 return NULL;
2875 }
2876 if (o->duplex3 < 0 || o->duplex3 > DUPLEX3_LEVEL_MAX) {
2877 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "RadioPlus/%s: duplex3 must be between 0 and %d\n", ctg,
2878 DUPLEX3_LEVEL_MAX);
2879 destroy_unlinked_channel(o);
2880 return NULL;
2881 }
2882
2883 if (o->rxsdtype != SD_XPMR) {
2884 o->rxctcssfreqs[0] = 0;
2885 o->txctcssfreqs[0] = 0;
2886 }
2887
2888 if ((o->txmixa == TX_OUT_COMPOSITE) && (o->txmixb == TX_OUT_VOICE)) {
2889 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Invalid Configuration: Can not have B channel be Voice with A "
2890 "channel being Composite!!\n");
2891 }
2892 if ((o->txmixb == TX_OUT_COMPOSITE) && (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_VOICE)) {
2893 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Invalid Configuration: Can not have A channel be Voice with B "
2894 "channel being Composite!!\n");
2895 }
2896
2897 if (o->plus_emphasis_corner_hz <= 0.0 || o->plus_emphasis_corner_hz >= 300.0) {
2898 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "RadioPlus/%s: invalid native DSP configuration\n", o->name);
2899 destroy_unlinked_channel(o);
2900 return NULL;
2901 }
2902 if (usbradioplus_dsp_init(o)) {
2903 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "RadioPlus/%s: native DSP initialization failed\n", o->name);
2904 destroy_unlinked_channel(o);
2905 return NULL;
2906 }
2907
2908 for (i = 2; i <= 9; i++) {
2909 /* skip if this one not specified */
2910 if (!o->pps[i]) {
2911 continue;
2912 }
2913 /* skip if not out or PTT */
2914 if (strncasecmp(o->pps[i], "out", 3) && strcasecmp(o->pps[i], "ptt")) {
2915 continue;
2916 }
2917 /* if default value is 1, set it */
2918 if (!strcasecmp(o->pps[i], "out1")) {
2919 pp_val |= (1 << (i - 2));
2920 }
2921 hasout = 1;
2922 }
2923
2924 /* if we are using the EEPROM, request hidthread load the EEPROM */
2925 if (o->wanteeprom) {
2926 ast_mutex_lock(&o->eepromlock);
2927 usbradioplus_wait_for_eeprom_idle(o);
2928 o->eepromctl = 1; /* request a load */
2929 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->eepromlock);
2930 }
2931 o->dsp = ast_dsp_new();
2932 if (o->dsp) {
2933 ast_dsp_set_features(o->dsp, DSP_FEATURE_DIGIT_DETECT);
2934 ast_dsp_set_digitmode(o->dsp, DSP_DIGITMODE_DTMF | DSP_DIGITMODE_MUTECONF |
2935 DSP_DIGITMODE_RELAXDTMF);
2936 }
2937 if (o->rxsqhyst == 0) {
2938 o->rxsqhyst = 3000;
2939 }
2940
2941 if (o->rxsquelchdelay > RXSQDELAYBUFSIZE / 8 - 1) {
2942 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "rxsquelchdelay of %i is > maximum of %i. Set to maximum.\n",
2943 o->rxsquelchdelay, RXSQDELAYBUFSIZE / 8 - 1);
2944 o->rxsquelchdelay = RXSQDELAYBUFSIZE / 8 - 1;
2945 }
2946 {
2947 urp_radio_state tChan;
2948
2949 memset(&tChan, 0, sizeof(urp_radio_state));
2950
2951 tChan.pTxCodeDefault = o->txctcssdefault;
2952 tChan.pRxCodeSrc = o->rxctcssfreqs;
2953 tChan.pTxCodeSrc = o->txctcssfreqs;
2954
2955 tChan.rxDemod = o->rxdemod;
2956 tChan.rxCdType = effective_rxcdtype(o);
2957 tChan.voxHangTime = o->voxhangtime;
2958 tChan.rxCarrierHyst = o->rxsqhyst;
2959 tChan.rxSqVoxAdj = o->rxsqvoxadj;
2960 tChan.rxSquelchDelay = o->rxsquelchdelay;
2961
2962 tChan.txMixA = effective_txmixa(o);
2963 tChan.txMixB = effective_txmixb(o);
2964
2965 tChan.rxCpuSaver = o->rxcpusaver;
2966 tChan.txCpuSaver = o->txcpusaver;
2967
2968 tChan.b.rxpolarity = o->rxpolarity;
2969 tChan.b.txpolarity = o->txpolarity;
2970
2971 tChan.b.dcsrxpolarity = o->dcsrxpolarity;
2972 tChan.b.dcstxpolarity = o->dcstxpolarity;
2973
2974 tChan.b.lsdrxpolarity = o->lsdrxpolarity;
2975 tChan.b.lsdtxpolarity = o->lsdtxpolarity;
2976
2977 tChan.tracetype = o->tracetype;
2978 tChan.tracelevel = o->tracelevel;
2979
2980 tChan.rptnum = o->rptnum;
2981 tChan.idleinterval = o->idleinterval;
2982 tChan.turnoffs = o->turnoffs;
2983 tChan.area = o->area;
2984 tChan.ukey = o->ukey;
2985 tChan.name = o->name;
2986 tChan.fever = o->fever;
2987
2988 tChan.rxhpf = o->rxhpf;
2989 tChan.rxlpf = o->rxlpf;
2990
2991 o->radio = urp_radio_create(&tChan, FRAME_SIZE);
2992 if (!o->radio) {
2993 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "RadioPlus/%s: signaling engine initialization failed\n",
2994 o->name);
2995 destroy_unlinked_channel(o);
2996 return NULL;
2997 }
2998
2999 o->radio->radioDuplex = o->radioduplex;
3000 o->radio->b.loopback = 0;
3001 o->radio->txsettletime = o->txsettletime;
3002 o->radio->txrxblankingtime = o->txrxblankingtime;
3003 o->radio->rxCpuSaver = o->rxcpusaver;
3004 o->radio->txCpuSaver = o->txcpusaver;
3005
3006 *(o->radio->prxSquelchAdjust) =
3007 ((999 - o->rxsquelchadj) * 32767) / AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT;
3008 *(o->radio->prxVoiceAdjust) = effective_rx_decoder_gain(o) * M_Q8;
3009 *(o->radio->prxCtcssAdjust) = o->rxctcssadj * M_Q8;
3010 o->radio->rxCtcss->relax = o->rxctcssrelax;
3011 o->radio->txTocType = o->txtoctype;
3012
3013 if (!urp_tx_pair_has_voice((enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixa,
3014 (enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixb)) {
3015 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "No txvoice output configured.\n");
3016 }
3017
3018 if (urp_tx_tone_route_missing(o->txctcssfreq, (enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixa,
3019 (enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixb)) {
3020 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "No txtone output configured.\n");
3021 }
3022
3023 if (o->radioactive) {
3024 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *ao;
3025 for (ao = usbradio_default.next; ao; ao = ao->next) {
3026 ao->radioactive = 0;
3027 }
3028 usbradio_active = o->name;
3029 o->radioactive = 1;
3030 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE, "radio active set to [%s]\n", o->name);
3031 }
3032 }
3033
3034 hidhdwconfig(o);
3035
3036 /* The default category returned above; every remaining object is listable. */
3037 o->next = usbradio_default.next;
3038 usbradio_default.next = o;
3039 return o;
3040}

3334URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int load_module(void)
3335{
3336 if (!(usbradio_tech.capabilities = ast_format_cap_alloc(AST_FORMAT_CAP_FLAG_DEFAULT))) {
3337 return AST_MODULE_LOAD_DECLINE;
3338 }
3339 ast_format_cap_append(usbradio_tech.capabilities, ast_format_slin, 0);
3340
3341 usbradio_active = NULL;
3342
3343 /* Copy the default jb config over global_jbconf */
3344 memcpy(&global_jbconf, &default_jbconf, sizeof(struct ast_jb_conf));
3345
3346 pp_val = 0;
3347 hasout = 0;
3348 if (usbradioplus_processing_prime()) {
3349 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Unable to start RadioPlus processing engine\n");
3350 return AST_MODULE_LOAD_FAILURE;
3351 }
3352
3353 /* load our module configuration */
3354 if (load_config(0)) {
3355 return AST_MODULE_LOAD_DECLINE;
3356 }
3357
3358 if (find_desc(usbradio_active) == NULL) {
3359 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE, "radio active device %s not found\n", usbradio_active);
3360 /* XXX we could default to 'dsp' perhaps ? */
3361 /* XXX should cleanup allocated memory etc. */
3362 return AST_MODULE_LOAD_DECLINE;
3363 }
3364
3365 if (ast_channel_register(&usbradio_tech)) {
3366 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Unable to register channel type 'usb'\n");
3367 return AST_MODULE_LOAD_FAILURE;
3368 }
3369
3370 ast_cli_register_multiple(cli_usbradio,
3371 sizeof(cli_usbradio) / sizeof(struct ast_cli_entry));
3372 if (usbradioplus_processing_load() != AST_MODULE_LOAD_SUCCESS) {
3373 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Unable to start RadioPlus processing engine\n");
3374 ast_cli_unregister_multiple(cli_usbradio, ARRAY_LEN(cli_usbradio));
3375 ast_channel_unregister(&usbradio_tech);
3376 return AST_MODULE_LOAD_FAILURE;
3377 }
3378 usbradio_start_parallel_pulser();
3379
3380 return AST_MODULE_LOAD_SUCCESS;
3381}
3382
3383URP_CHANNEL_LOCAL int unload_module(void)
3384{
3385 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o;
3386 size_t i;
3387
3388 stoppulser = 1;
3389 usbradioplus_processing_unload();
3390
3391 ast_channel_unregister(&usbradio_tech);
3392 ast_cli_unregister_multiple(cli_usbradio,
3393 sizeof(cli_usbradio) / sizeof(struct ast_cli_entry));
3394
3395 for (o = usbradio_default.next; o; o = o->next) {
3396#if DEBUG_CAPTURES == 1
3397 if (frxcapraw) {
3398 fclose(frxcapraw);
3399 frxcapraw = NULL;
3400 }
3401 if (frxcaptrace) {
3402 fclose(frxcaptrace);
3403 frxcaptrace = NULL;
3404 }
3405 if (frxoutraw) {
3406 fclose(frxoutraw);
3407 frxoutraw = NULL;
3408 }
3409 if (ftxcapraw) {
3410 fclose(ftxcapraw);
3411 ftxcapraw = NULL;
3412 }
3413 if (ftxcaptrace) {
3414 fclose(ftxcaptrace);
3415 ftxcaptrace = NULL;
3416 }
3417 if (ftxoutraw) {
3418 fclose(ftxoutraw);
3419 ftxoutraw = NULL;
3420 }
3421#endif
3422
3423 if (o->owner) {
3424 ast_softhangup(o->owner, AST_SOFTHANGUP_APPUNLOAD);
3425 }
3426 o->stopaudiothread = 1;
3427 o->stophid = 1;
3428 kickptt(o);
3429 if (o->audiothread != AST_PTHREADT_NULL) {
3430 pthread_join(o->audiothread, NULL);
3431 o->audiothread = AST_PTHREADT_NULL;
3432 }
3433 if (o->hidthread != AST_PTHREADT_NULL) {
3434 pthread_join(o->hidthread, NULL);
3435 o->hidthread = AST_PTHREADT_NULL;
3436 }
3437 ast_radio_pa_stop(&o->pa);
3438 usbradio_release_device(o);
3439 usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(o);
3440 if (o->radio) {
3441 urp_radio_destroy(o->radio);
3442 o->radio = NULL;
3443 }
3444 if (o->dsp) {
3445 ast_dsp_free(o->dsp);
3446 }
3447 for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PINCOUNT; i++) {
3448 if (o->gpios[i]) {
3449 ast_free(o->gpios[i]);
3450 }
3451 }
3452 for (i = 0; i < ARRAY_LEN(o->pps); i++) {
3453 if (o->pps[i]) {
3454 ast_free(o->pps[i]);
3455 }
3456 }
3457 }
3458
3459 ao2_cleanup(usbradio_tech.capabilities);
3460 usbradio_tech.capabilities = NULL;
3461
3462 return 0;
3463}
